```js
                    // An unreachable host keeps what it showed last (greyed out); a host that answers "not prepared" shows nothing stale.
                    const keep = info.code === 'host_unreachable' && previous;
                    state.stacks[hostId] = { listing: keep ? previous.listing : null, loaded: !!(keep && previous.loaded), error: info, at: keep ? previous.at : 0 };
                    return false;
                } finally { emit(); }
            });
        }

        function abortStack() { controllers.get('stack')?.abort(); stackGen += 1; }
        function openStack(hostId, name, tab) {
            if (state.disposed || !hostId || !name) return;
            const key = hostId + '/' + name, wanted = stackModel.STACK_TABS.includes(tab) ? tab : '';
            if (state.stack && state.stack.key === key) {
                if (wanted) state.stack.tab = wanted;
                emit();
                return;
            }
            abortStack();
            state.stack = { key, hostId, name, tab: wanted || 'overview', status: 'loading', detail: null, error: null };
            emit();
            void loadStack();
        }
        function closeStack() {
            if (!state.stack) return;
            abortStack();
            state.stack = null;
            emit();
        }
        function setStackTab(tab) {
            if (!state.stack || !stackModel.STACK_TABS.includes(tab) || state.stack.tab === tab) return;
            state.stack.tab = tab;
            emit();
        }
        // `quiet` (the poll) keeps the stack on screen when a reload fails; only a vanished stack is reported.
        async function loadStack(quiet) {
            const target = state.stack;
            if (!target) return false;
            controllers.get('stack')?.abort();
            const gen = ++stackGen;
            if (!quiet) { target.status = 'loading'; emit(); }
            try {
                const body = await request('/hosts/' + enc(target.hostId) + '/stacks/' + enc(target.name), { timeout: STACK_TIMEOUT_MS }, 'stack');
                if (state.disposed || state.stack !== target || gen !== stackGen) return false;
                target.detail = body.stack || null;
                target.status = target.detail ? 'ok' : 'error';
                target.error = target.detail ? null : { code: 'unknown', message: '' };
            } catch (error) {
                const info = noteError(error);
                if (state.disposed || !info || state.stack !== target || gen !== stackGen) return false;
                if (quiet && target.detail && info.code !== 'stack_not_found') return false;
                target.status = 'error';
                target.error = info;
            }
            emit();
            return true;
        }

        // files = {compose?: {content, revision}, env?: {content, revision}}. Rejects with .dm; a revision_conflict carries
        // data.file and data.current (the file as it is on the host now).
        async function saveFiles(hostId, name, files) {
            const body = await guarded(() => request('/hosts/' + enc(hostId) + '/stacks/' + enc(name) + '/files', { method: 'PUT', body: files }));
            const revisions = body.revisions || {};
            const detail = state.stack && state.stack.hostId === hostId && state.stack.name === name ? state.stack.detail : null;
            if (detail) {
                for (const file of ['compose', 'env']) {
                    if (files[file] && revisions[file] !== undefined) detail[file] = Object.assign({}, detail[file], { content: files[file].content, revision: revisions[file], exists: true });
                }
                if (files.env) detail.has_env = true;
            }
            void loadStacks(hostId);
            emit();
            return revisions;
        }

        // input = {name, compose, env?, deploy?}. Answers {stack, operation?, deploy_error?}; a deploying create follows its operation.
        // When the files were written but the deployment could not start, the answer is still a 201 with deploy_error {code, message}
        // and no operation: the create succeeded, the caller reports the error.
        async function createStack(hostId, input) {
            const payload = { name: input.name, compose: input.compose };
            if (typeof input.env === 'string' && input.env !== '') payload.env = input.env;
            if (input.deploy) payload.deploy = true;
            const body = await guarded(() => request('/hosts/' + enc(hostId) + '/stacks', { method: 'POST', body: payload, timeout: STACK_TIMEOUT_MS }));
            if (body.operation) trackOperation(body.operation);
            void loadStacks(hostId, true);
            return body;
        }

        async function loadHelpers(hostId) {
            const body = await guarded(() => request('/hosts/' + enc(hostId) + '/helpers', { timeout: STACK_TIMEOUT_MS }));
            return body.helpers || null;
        }
        async function loadVolumes(hostId, name) {
            const body = await guarded(() => request('/hosts/' + enc(hostId) + '/stacks/' + enc(name) + '/volumes', { timeout: STACK_TIMEOUT_MS }));
            return list(body.volumes);
        }
        // Lint never blocks anything. `slot` names the editor asking: a newer request of the same slot cancels the older one
        // (that one rejects with .dm.code === 'aborted').
        function lint(hostId, input, slot) {
            const key = 'lint:' + (slot || '');
            controllers.get(key)?.abort();
            return guarded(() => request('/hosts/' + enc(hostId) + '/lint', { method: 'POST', body: input, timeout: STACK_TIMEOUT_MS }, key));
        }
        function convertDockerRun(command) {
            return guarded(() => request('/convert/docker-run', { method: 'POST', body: { command } }));
        }
        // action: start | stop | restart on every container of an external compose project.
        async function projectAction(hostId, project, action) {
            await guarded(() => request('/hosts/' + enc(hostId) + '/projects/' + enc(project) + '/' + enc(action), { method: 'POST' }));
            void reloadContainers(hostId);
            void loadStacks(hostId, true);
        }

        // ---- operations -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        function closeSource(entry) {
            if (!entry.source) return;
            try { entry.source.close(); } catch (error) { /* already closed */ }
            entry.source = null;
        }

        // Called once per entry when an operation seen running ends: refresh what it changed and tell the listeners.
        function finished(entry) {
            if (entry.final || state.disposed) return;
            entry.final = true;
            const op = entry.op, hostId = String(op.host_id || '');
            if (hostId) {
                void loadStacks(hostId, true);
                void reloadContainers(hostId);
                const open = state.stack && state.stack.hostId === hostId && state.stack.name === op.stack;
                if (open && op.kind === 'delete' && op.state === 'succeeded') closeStack();
                else if (open) void loadStack(true);
            }
            for (const listener of [...doneListeners]) {
                try { listener(entry); } catch (error) { console.error('Docker Manager:', error); }
            }
            emit();
        }

        // After a broken stream: read the operation itself (it may have ended meanwhile), then listen again. Without
        // EventSource this is the whole mechanism: the operation is read every 2 s.
        async function resync(entry) {
            if (state.disposed || !stackModel.isActiveOp(entry.op)) return;
            try {
                const body = await request('/operations/' + enc(entry.id));
                if (state.disposed) return;
                if (body.operation) stackModel.applySnapshot(entry, Object.assign({ output: entry.output }, body.operation));
            } catch (error) {
                const info = noteError(error);
                if (info && info.code === 'operation_not_found') entry.op = Object.assign({}, entry.op, { state: 'interrupted' });
            }
            if (!stackModel.isActiveOp(entry.op)) { entry.stream = 'closed'; finished(entry); } else follow(entry);
            emit();
        }
        function later(entry, delay) {
            clearTimeout(entry.timer);
            entry.timer = setTimeout(() => { entry.timer = 0; void resync(entry); }, delay);
        }

        // One EventSource per active operation, closed on "done". snapshot replaces what the entry knows (first connect and
        // every reconnect); output, progress and state add to it.
        function follow(entry) {
            if (state.disposed || entry.source || entry.timer || !stackModel.isActiveOp(entry.op)) return;
            if (!openStream) { entry.stream = 'retry'; later(entry, 2000); return; }
            const source = openStream(BASE + '/operations/' + enc(entry.id) + '/stream');
            entry.source = source;
            entry.stream = 'connecting';
            const on = (type, handler) => source.addEventListener(type, event => {
                if (entry.source !== source || state.disposed) return;
                const data = stackModel.parseJSON(event && event.data);
                if (!data) return;
                entry.failures = 0;
                entry.stream = 'live';
                handler(data);
                emit();
            });
            on('snapshot', op => {
                stackModel.applySnapshot(entry, op);
                if (!stackModel.isActiveOp(entry.op)) { closeSource(entry); entry.stream = 'closed'; finished(entry); }
            });
            for (const type of ['output', 'progress', 'state']) on(type, event => stackModel.applyOpEvent(entry, event));
            on('done', op => {
                closeSource(entry);
                entry.stream = 'closed';
                stackModel.applyOpEvent(entry, { type: 'done', operation: op });
                finished(entry);
            });
            source.onerror = () => {
                if (entry.source !== source) return;
                closeSource(entry);
                if (state.disposed || !stackModel.isActiveOp(entry.op)) return;
                entry.stream = 'retry';
                entry.failures = (entry.failures || 0) + 1;
                later(entry, reconnectMs[Math.min(entry.failures, reconnectMs.length) - 1]);
                emit();
            };
        }

        // Adds an operation to the drawer (or refreshes its entry) and follows it while it runs. An operation first seen
        // finished never reaches the done listeners. An entry that exists keeps its output and progress: the list answers
        // (GET /operations) and the start answers carry no output, so they only update the state, the times and the error. A
        // stream snapshot, "done" and the re-read of resync are what replace the output.
        function trackOperation(op) {
            if (!op || !op.id || state.disposed) return null;
            let entry = findEntry(op.id);
            if (entry) entry.op = Object.assign({}, entry.op, op, { output: entry.op.output });
            else {
                entry = stackModel.newOpEntry(op, Date.now());
                if (!stackModel.isActiveOp(entry.op)) entry.final = true;
                state.ops = stackModel.trimEntries([entry].concat(state.ops), KEEP_FINISHED);
            }
            if (stackModel.isActiveOp(entry.op)) follow(entry); else finished(entry);
            emit();
            return entry;
        }
        function attachOperation(id) {
            return once('op:' + id, async () => {
                if (findEntry(id)) return findEntry(id);
                try {
                    const body = await request('/operations/' + enc(id));
                    return trackOperation(body.operation);
                } catch (error) { noteError(error); return null; }
            });
        }
        // The stack listing names the operation running on a stack: pick up the ones this window did not start.
        function adoptOperations(listing) {
            for (const stack of listing.stacks) {
                const ref = stack && stack.operation;
                if (ref && ref.id && !findEntry(ref.id)) void attachOperation(ref.id);
            }
        }
        function loadActiveOperations() {
            return once('ops:active', async () => {
                try {
                    const body = await request('/operations?active=1');
                    for (const op of list(body.operations)) trackOperation(op);
                } catch (error) { noteError(error); } finally { emit(); }
            });
        }
        // filter = {host, stack, active, limit}. Plain reads for callers that want history; nothing is tracked.
        async function loadOperations(filter) {
            const f = filter || {}, params = [];
            if (f.host) params.push('host=' + enc(f.host));
            if (f.stack) params.push('stack=' + enc(f.stack));
            if (f.active) params.push('active=1');
            if (f.limit) params.push('limit=' + Number(f.limit));
            const body = await guarded(() => request('/operations' + (params.length ? '?' + params.join('&') : '')));
            return list(body.operations);
        }
        async function loadOperation(id) {
            const body = await guarded(() => request('/operations/' + enc(id)));
            return body.operation || null;
        }

        // Resolves {ok: true, entry} or {ok: false, error, busy?}. busy names the operation already running on that stack:
        // the caller attaches to its stream instead of reporting an error.
        async function operationResult(run) {
            if (state.disposed) return { ok: false, error: { code: 'aborted' } };
            try {
                const body = await run();
                const entry = trackOperation(body.operation);
                return { ok: !!entry, entry, operation: body.operation };
            } catch (error) {
                const info = noteError(error);
                if (!info) return { ok: false, error: { code: 'aborted' } };
                emit();
                if (info.code === 'operation_in_progress' && info.data && info.data.operation_id) {
                    void attachOperation(info.data.operation_id);
                    return { ok: false, error: info, busy: info.data.operation_id };
                }
                return { ok: false, error: info };
            }
        }
        // kind: config | up | down | stop | restart | pull | update. `volumes` adds --volumes to down.
        function startOp(hostId, name, kind, o) {
            const body = { kind };
            if (o && o.volumes) body.volumes = true;
            return operationResult(() => request('/hosts/' + enc(hostId) + '/stacks/' + enc(name) + '/ops', { method: 'POST', body }));
        }
        function prepareHost(hostId) {
            return operationResult(() => request('/hosts/' + enc(hostId) + '/prepare', { method: 'POST' }));
        }
        function deleteStack(hostId, name, volumes) {
            return operationResult(() => request('/hosts/' + enc(hostId) + '/stacks/' + enc(name) + (volumes ? '?volumes=1' : ''), { method: 'DELETE' }));
        }
        // Listeners get the entry of every operation that ended while this window watched it.
        function onOperationDone(listener) { doneListeners.add(listener); return () => doneListeners.delete(listener); }
        const activeOps = () => state.ops.filter(entry => stackModel.isActiveOp(entry.op));

        function dispose() {
            if (state.disposed) return;
            state.disposed = true;
            state.visible = false;
            clearTimeout(timer);
            timer = 0;
            for (const entry of state.ops) { closeSource(entry); clearTimeout(entry.timer); entry.timer = 0; }
            lifetime.abort();
            detach();
            listeners.clear();
            doneListeners.clear();
        }

        return {
            state, subscribe, attach, setVisible, setScope, setSection, refresh, loadHosts, loadContainers, reloadContainers, pollOnce, pending,
            act, remove, openDetail, closeDetail, setDetailTab, loadLogs, loadInspect, canMutate, canEditHosts,
            testDraft, saveHost, deleteHost, testHost, loadNests, importNest,
            loadStacks, openStack, closeStack, setStackTab, loadStack, saveFiles, createStack, loadHelpers, loadVolumes, lint, convertDockerRun, projectAction,
            startOp, prepareHost, deleteStack, loadOperations, loadOperation, loadActiveOperations, attachOperation, trackOperation, onOperationDone, activeOps, dispose
        };
    }

    window.DockerManagerStore = { create, LOG_TAILS, POLL_MS, STACK_TIMEOUT_MS };
})();
```

```js
    assert.ok(rail.includes('data-section="stacks"') && /data-section="stacks"[^>]*aria-current="page"/.test(rail) && !/data-section="containers"[^>]*aria-current/.test(rail), 'the rail marks the current section');
    const head = stacks.head(snap), overview = stacks.overview(snap);
    assert.ok(head.includes('data-op="update"') && head.includes('data-op="restart"') && head.includes('class="dm-dirty"'), 'a running stack offers Update, and an unsaved compose tab is marked');
    assert.ok(stacks.head(Object.assign({}, snap, { stackOps: { 'local/shop': { op: { kind: 'up', state: 'running' } } } })).includes('data-op="update"') && /data-op="update"[^>]*disabled/.test(stacks.head(Object.assign({}, snap, { stackOps: { 'local/shop': { op: { kind: 'up', state: 'running' } } } }))), 'a stack with a running operation cannot start another');
    assert.ok(!stacks.head(Object.assign({}, snap, { canMutate: false })).includes('data-op='), 'a read-only window shows no operation buttons');
    assert.ok(overview.includes('href="http://desk.lan:8080"') && overview.includes('rel="noopener noreferrer"') && !overview.includes('<b>web'), 'ports are links to the page host name, services are escaped');
    const shell = stacks.shell(snap.state.stack);
    assert.ok(shell.includes('data-ed-surface="compose"') && shell.includes('data-ed-surface="env"') && shell.includes('data-action="save-deploy"'), 'the shell holds the two editors and their toolbars');
    assert.ok(stacks.problem(Object.assign({}, snap, { state: Object.assign({}, snap.state, { stack: { key: 'local/gone', name: 'gone', status: 'error', error: { code: 'stack_not_found' } } }) })).includes('stack_gone'), 'a vanished stack says so');
}

// ---- the owner of a 409 protected-confirmation answer gets the translated sentence, never the server's message -----------------
{
    const t = (key, params) => key + (params ? JSON.stringify(params) : '');
    const views = full.DockerManagerViews.create({ t, esc: String, model: full.DockerManagerModel, lang: 'en', uid: 'x' });
    eq(['self', 'docker-endpoint', 'shared-network', 'unverified', 'docker_manager', 'ruview', ''].map(views.protectedLabelText),
        ['protected_self', 'protected_endpoint', 'protected_network', 'protected_unverified', 'protected_helper', 'protected_owner{"owner":"ruview"}', ''], 'a helper container of the Stacks feature names itself, not an owner');
}

// ---- error texts: the codes of the host and operation routes, and the deploy that could not start -------------------------------
{
    const t = (key, params) => key + (params ? JSON.stringify(params) : '');
    const views = full.DockerManagerViews.create({ t, esc: String, model: full.DockerManagerModel, lang: 'en', uid: 'x' });
    for (const code of ['invalid_operation', 'operation_not_found', 'docker_error', 'host_not_found', 'invalid_action', 'internal_error', 'bad_request']) {
        assert.ok(views.errorText({ code, message: 'English' }).startsWith('error_' + code), code + ' has its own text');
    }
    assert.ok(views.errorText({ code: 'docker_error', message: 'cause' }).endsWith(' cause'), 'the message of a Docker error names the cause');
    assert.ok(!views.errorText({ code: 'internal_error', message: 'The deployment could not be started' }).includes('deployment'), 'the code decides, the English message of a deploy_error does not show');
    assert.equal(views.errorText({ code: 'brand_new', message: 'English' }), 'error_unknown English', 'an unknown code shows the generic sentence and the message');
}

// ---- translations: every key the code can ask for exists in all sixteen locales with the same placeholders -------------------
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Create `ui/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-stacks.js`.**

```js
/* Docker Manager stacks: HTML builders for the Stacks section, the stack list with its three groups and the host cards
   ("Prepare host", API too old, folder unavailable), and the stack detail pane (header, tabs, overview, the static shell
   the editors are mounted into). A classic script (window.DockerManagerStacks) with no DOM work at load. Every function
   takes a snapshot and returns a string; docker-manager.js inserts it and routes the events through data-action hooks.
   User data (names, paths, images, messages) always goes through esc(); colour comes from data-tone and data-host-color. */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    const PORTS_SHOWN = 3;
    const FILE_NAMES = { compose: 'compose.yaml', env: '.env' };

    function create(deps) {
        const { t, esc, model, stackModel, views, uid } = deps;
        const { glyph, dot, chip } = views;
        const sm = stackModel;

        const statusText = stack => t('stack_status_' + sm.stackStatusId(stack));
        const button = (action, label, o) => {
            const x = o || {};
            return '<button type="button" class="dm-btn' + (x.primary ? ' is-primary' : '') + (x.danger ? ' is-danger' : '') + '" data-action="' + action + '"' + (x.attrs || '')
                + ' data-focus-id="' + esc(x.focus || action) + '"' + (x.disabled ? ' disabled aria-busy="' + (x.busy ? 'true' : 'false') + '"' : '') + '>' + (x.glyph ? glyph(x.glyph) : '') + '<span>' + esc(label) + '</span></button>';
        };
        const iconButton = (action, label, glyphName, attrs, o) => {
            const x = o || {};
            return '<button type="button" class="dm-icon-btn' + (x.danger ? ' is-danger' : '') + '" data-action="' + action + '"' + (attrs || '') + ' data-focus-id="' + esc(x.focus || action)
                + '" aria-label="' + esc(label) + '" title="' + esc(label) + '"' + (x.disabled ? ' disabled' : '') + (x.busy ? ' aria-busy="true"' : '') + '>' + glyph(glyphName) + '</button>';
        };
        const opBadge = op => (op ? '<span class="dm-opbadge" role="status"><span class="dm-spinner is-small" aria-hidden="true"></span>' + esc(t('op_kind_' + op.kind)) + '</span>' : '');
        const spinner = () => '<div class="dm-empty-inner is-loading" role="status"><span class="dm-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span><p>' + esc(t('loading')) + '</p></div>';

        function ageText(created, now) {
            const age = sm.age(created, now);
            return age ? t('stack_up', { age: t('age_' + age.unit, { count: age.n }) }) : '';
        }

        // Published ports in a list row: plain labels (the row is a button; the links live in the detail pane).
        function portChips(ports) {
            const seen = new Set(), labels = [];
            for (const port of (Array.isArray(ports) ? ports : [])) {
                const published = port && Number(port.public_port);
                if (published && !seen.has(published)) { seen.add(published); labels.push(published); }
            }
            labels.sort((a, b) => a - b);
            if (!labels.length) return '';
            const shown = labels.slice(0, PORTS_SHOWN).map(label => '<span class="dm-port">' + label + '</span>').join('');
            return '<span class="dm-srow-ports">' + shown + (labels.length > PORTS_SHOWN ? '<span class="dm-port is-more" title="' + esc(labels.slice(PORTS_SHOWN).join(', ')) + '">+' + (labels.length - PORTS_SHOWN) + '</span>' : '') + '</span>';
        }

        // ---- host cards --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        function helperFacts(helpers) {
            const h = helpers || {};
            const line = (ok, label) => '<li>' + dot(ok ? 'ok' : 'bad') + '<span>' + esc(label) + '</span></li>';
            return '<ul class="dm-facts-inline">' + line(!!h.runner_image_present, t(h.runner_image_present ? 'prepare_image_ok' : 'prepare_image_missing'))
                + line(h.io_container === 'ok', t(h.io_container === 'ok' ? 'prepare_io_ok' : h.io_container === 'mismatch' ? 'prepare_io_mismatch' : 'prepare_io_missing')) + '</ul>';
        }

        function hostCard(snap, host, state) {
            const entry = snap.state.stacks[host.id] || {}, error = entry.error || {}, data = error.data || {};
            const id = uid + '-hostcard-' + host.id;
            const head = chip(host.name, model.colorOf(host.color));
            const card = (tone, glyphName, title, body, extra, action) => '<section class="dm-hostcard" data-tone="' + tone + '" data-host-card="' + esc(host.id) + '" aria-labelledby="' + esc(id) + '"><span class="dm-banner-icon">' + glyph(glyphName) + '</span>'
                + '<div class="dm-hostcard-body"><h3 id="' + esc(id) + '">' + head + ' <span>' + esc(title) + '</span></h3><p>' + esc(body) + '</p>' + (extra || '') + '</div>' + (action || '') + '</section>';
            if (state === 'not_prepared') {
                const busy = !!snap.prepareActive[host.id];
                const action = snap.canMutate ? button('prepare-host', busy ? t('prepare_running') : t('prepare_button'), { primary: true, glyph: 'download', attrs: ' data-host-id="' + esc(host.id) + '"', focus: 'prepare:' + host.id, disabled: busy, busy }) : '';
                return card('warn', 'download', t('prepare_title'), t('prepare_body', { image: data.helpers && data.helpers.runner_image ? data.helpers.runner_image : 'docker:29.9.2-cli' }), helperFacts(data.helpers), action);
            }
            if (state === 'api_too_old') return card('warn', 'warning', t('api_old_title'), t('error_api_too_old', { version: String(data.api_version || '?'), command: '' }));
            if (state === 'unreachable') return card('bad', 'warning', t('host_error'), views.reasonText(error.reason), '', '');
            return card('warn', 'warning', t('stacks_unavailable_title'), views.errorText(error), '', '');
        }

        // ---- the list ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        // The rows of a host whose last listing failed are what it showed before: greyed out.
        const staleAttr = (snap, hostId) => (snap.state.stacks[hostId] && snap.state.stacks[hostId].error ? ' data-stale="true"' : '');

        function stackRow(snap, row) {
            const s = Object.assign({ services: { total: 0, running: 0 }, ports: [] }, row.stack), tone = sm.stackTone(s), open = !!(snap.state.stack && snap.state.stack.key === row.key && !snap.state.detail);
            const op = s.operation && sm.isActiveState(s.operation.state) ? s.operation : null;
            const sub = [statusText(s), s.services.total ? t('count_running_total', { running: s.services.running, total: s.services.total }) : t('stack_no_services')].join(' · ');
            return '<li class="dm-srow" data-tone="' + tone + '"' + staleAttr(snap, row.hostId) + '><button type="button" class="dm-srow-main" data-action="open-stack" data-stack-key="' + esc(row.key) + '" data-snav="' + esc(row.key) + '" data-focus-id="srow:' + esc(row.key)
                + '" tabindex="-1"' + (open ? ' aria-current="true"' : '') + '>' + dot(tone) + '<span class="dm-srow-text"><span class="dm-name-line"><span class="dm-name">' + esc(s.name) + '</span>' + (snap.multi ? chip(row.hostName, model.colorOf(row.hostColor)) : '')
                + '</span><span class="dm-sub">' + esc(sub) + '</span></span>' + portChips(s.ports) + opBadge(op) + '</button></li>';
        }

        function externalRow(snap, row) {
            const p = Object.assign({ services: { total: 0, running: 0 }, ports: [] }, row.project), tone = sm.stackTone(p), busy = snap.state.busy.has(row.key);
            const sub = [statusText(p), t('count_running_total', { running: p.services.running, total: p.services.total }), p.working_dir].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
            const attrs = ' data-host-id="' + esc(row.hostId) + '" data-project="' + esc(p.name) + '"';
            const actions = snap.canMutate ? '<div class="dm-srow-actions" role="group" aria-label="' + esc(t('row_actions_label', { name: p.name })) + '">'
                + iconButton('project-action', t('action_start') + ': ' + p.name, 'play', attrs + ' data-act="start"', { focus: 'xp:' + row.key + ':start', disabled: busy })
                + iconButton('project-action', t('action_stop') + ': ' + p.name, 'stop', attrs + ' data-act="stop"', { focus: 'xp:' + row.key + ':stop', disabled: busy })
                + iconButton('project-action', t('action_restart') + ': ' + p.name, 'restart', attrs + ' data-act="restart"', { focus: 'xp:' + row.key + ':restart', disabled: busy }) + '</div>' : '';
            return '<li class="dm-srow" data-tone="' + tone + '"' + staleAttr(snap, row.hostId) + '><button type="button" class="dm-srow-main" data-action="show-project" data-project="' + esc(p.name) + '" data-snav="' + esc(row.key) + '" data-focus-id="srow:' + esc(row.key) + '" tabindex="-1">'
                + dot(tone) + '<span class="dm-srow-text"><span class="dm-name-line"><span class="dm-name">' + esc(p.name) + '</span>' + (snap.multi ? chip(row.hostName, model.colorOf(row.hostColor)) : '')
                + '</span><span class="dm-sub" title="' + esc(p.working_dir) + '">' + esc(sub) + '</span></span>' + portChips(p.ports) + '</button>' + actions + '</li>';
        }

        function singleRow(snap, row) {
            const c = row.c, status = model.statusOf(c), name = model.containerName(c), lock = model.isProtected(c);
            const sub = [views.statusLabel(status), model.shortImage(c.image)].join(' · ');
            return '<li class="dm-srow" data-tone="' + status.tone + '"><button type="button" class="dm-srow-main" data-action="open-container" data-row-key="' + esc(row.key) + '" data-snav="c:' + esc(row.key) + '" data-focus-id="srow:c:' + esc(row.key) + '" tabindex="-1"'
                + (snap.state.detail && snap.state.detail.key === row.key ? ' aria-current="true"' : '') + '>' + dot(status.tone) + '<span class="dm-srow-text"><span class="dm-name-line"><span class="dm-name">' + esc(name) + '</span>'
                + (lock ? '<span class="dm-lock" role="img" aria-label="' + esc(views.protectedText(c)) + '" title="' + esc(views.protectedText(c)) + '">' + glyph('lock') + '</span>' : '') + (snap.multi ? chip(row.hostName, row.hostColor) : '')
                + '</span><span class="dm-sub">' + esc(sub) + '</span></span></button></li>';
        }

        function group(key, title, count, items) {
            const id = uid + '-g-' + key;
            return '<section class="dm-sgroup" data-sgroup="' + key + '" aria-labelledby="' + id + '"><h3 class="dm-sgroup-title" id="' + id + '">' + esc(title) + '<span class="dm-count">' + count + '</span></h3><ul class="dm-slist">' + items.join('') + '</ul></section>';
        }

        function ignoredNote(snap) {
            const names = [];
            for (const host of snap.scopeHosts) {
                const entry = snap.state.stacks[host.id], ignored = entry && entry.listing ? entry.listing.ignored : [];
                for (const item of ignored) names.push(snap.multi ? host.name + '/' + item.name : item.name);
            }
            return names.length ? '<p class="dm-hint dm-ignored">' + esc(t('ignored_note', { count: names.length, names: names.slice(0, 6).join(', ') })) + '</p>' : '';
        }

        // The whole list pane: host cards first, then the groups. '' means "nothing to show yet" (the loading state paints).
        function list(snap) {
            const cards = [];
            let loading = 0;
            for (const host of snap.scopeHosts) {
                const state = snap.hostStates[host.id];
                // The banner above the list already explains a host whose containers could not be read either.
                const banner = state === 'unreachable' && snap.state.byHost[host.id] && snap.state.byHost[host.id].error;
                if (state === 'loading') loading += 1;
                else if (state !== 'ok' && !banner) cards.push(hostCard(snap, host, state));
            }
            const g = snap.sgroups, shown = g.stacks.length + g.external.length + g.singles.length;
            const parts = cards.slice();
            if (g.stacks.length) parts.push(group('stacks', t('group_stacks'), g.stacks.length, g.stacks.map(row => stackRow(snap, row))));
            if (g.external.length) parts.push(group('external', t('group_external'), g.external.length, g.external.map(row => externalRow(snap, row))));
            if (g.singles.length) parts.push(group('singles', t('group_single'), g.singles.length, g.singles.map(row => singleRow(snap, row))));
            const listed = snap.scopeHosts.length > 0 && snap.scopeHosts.every(host => snap.hostStates[host.id] === 'ok');
            if (!shown && !cards.length) {
                if (loading || !snap.state.hostsLoaded) return spinner();
                if (snap.query) return '<div class="dm-empty-inner">' + glyph('search', 'dm-empty-glyph') + '<h3>' + esc(t('no_match_title')) + '</h3><p>' + esc(t('no_match_body')) + '</p>' + button('clear-filters', t('clear_filters'), {}) + '</div>';
                if (listed) return '<div class="dm-empty-inner">' + glyph('stacks', 'dm-empty-glyph') + '<h3>' + esc(t('empty_stacks_title')) + '</h3><p>' + esc(t('empty_stacks_body')) + '</p>'
                    + (snap.canMutate ? button('new-stack', t('new_stack'), { primary: true, glyph: 'plus' }) : '') + '</div>';
                return '';
            }
            if (loading && !shown) parts.push(spinner());
            parts.push(ignoredNote(snap));
            return parts.join('');
        }

        // ---- the detail pane ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        function serviceRow(snap, hostId, service, host) {
            const tone = sm.serviceTone(service), state = sm.serviceStateId(service);
            const exit = state === 'exited' && service.exit_code != null ? ' · ' + t('svc_exit', { code: service.exit_code }) : '';
            const health = service.health ? ' · ' + t('svc_health_' + (['healthy', 'unhealthy', 'starting'].includes(service.health) ? service.health : 'none')) : '';
            const links = sm.portLinks(service.ports, sm.linkAddress(host, snap.pageHost));
            const ports = links.length ? '<span class="dm-svc-ports">' + links.map(link => (link.url
                ? '<a class="dm-portlink" href="' + esc(link.url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="' + esc(link.url) + '">' + esc(link.label) + '</a>'
                : '<span class="dm-port" title="' + esc(t('port_not_linked')) + '">' + esc(link.label) + '</span>')).join('') + '</span>' : '';
            const open = service.container_id && snap.state.byHost[hostId] && snap.state.byHost[hostId].containers.some(c => c && c.id === service.container_id)
                ? iconButton('open-service-container', t('svc_open_container', { name: service.name }), 'inspect', ' data-container-id="' + esc(service.container_id) + '"', { focus: 'svc:' + service.name }) : '';
            return '<li class="dm-svc" data-tone="' + tone + '">' + dot(tone) + '<div class="dm-svc-text"><span class="dm-name">' + esc(service.name) + '</span><span class="dm-sub" title="' + esc(service.image) + '">'
                + esc([t('svc_state_' + state) + health + exit, model.shortImage(service.image)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')) + '</span></div>' + ports + open + '</li>';
        }

        function overview(snap) {
            const stack = snap.state.stack, detail = stack && stack.detail;
            if (!detail) return '';
            const host = snap.hosts.find(item => item.id === stack.hostId) || {};
            const services = Array.isArray(detail.service_list) ? detail.service_list : [];
            const parts = [];
            if (detail.parse_error) parts.push('<p class="dm-note">' + glyph('warning') + '<span>' + esc(t('parse_error', { message: detail.parse_error })) + '</span></p>');
            if (!services.length) parts.push('<p class="dm-muted">' + esc(sm.stackStatusId(detail) === 'draft' ? t('overview_draft') : t('overview_no_services')) + '</p>');
            else parts.push('<ul class="dm-svclist" aria-label="' + esc(t('overview_services')) + '">' + services.map(service => serviceRow(snap, stack.hostId, service, host)).join('') + '</ul>');
            const facts = [
                '<div class="dm-fact"><dt>' + esc(t('ov_path')) + '</dt><dd>' + esc(detail.dir) + '</dd></div>',
                '<div class="dm-fact"><dt>' + esc(t('ov_files')) + '</dt><dd>' + esc(detail.compose_file || FILE_NAMES.compose) + (detail.has_env ? ' · .env' : '') + '</dd></div>'
            ];
            parts.push('<dl class="dm-facts">' + facts.join('') + '</dl>');
            return parts.join('');
        }

        // Header of the pane: name, host, path, age, the two icon buttons, the accent button and the more menu.
        function head(snap) {
            const stack = snap.state.stack;
            if (!stack) return '';
            const detail = stack.detail, summary = detail || { name: stack.name, status: 'stopped', services: { total: 0, running: 0 } };
            const status = sm.stackStatusId(summary), actions = sm.stackActions(summary), tone = sm.STACK_TONE[status];
            const host = snap.hosts.find(item => item.id === stack.hostId) || { id: stack.hostId, name: stack.hostId };
            const op = snap.stackOps[stack.key] || null, busy = !!op;
            const can = snap.canMutate && !!detail;
            const attrs = ' data-stack-key="' + esc(stack.key) + '"';
            const buttons = can ? iconButton('stack-op', t('action_restart') + ': ' + stack.name, 'restart', attrs + ' data-op="restart"', { focus: 'sd:restart', disabled: busy || !actions.restart })
                + iconButton('stack-op', t('action_stop') + ': ' + stack.name, 'stop', attrs + ' data-op="stop"', { focus: 'sd:stop', disabled: busy || !actions.stop })
                + button('stack-op', t('action_' + actions.primary), { primary: true, glyph: actions.primary === 'update' ? 'refresh' : 'deploy', attrs: attrs + ' data-op="' + actions.primary + '"', focus: 'sd:primary', disabled: busy, busy })
                + iconButton('stack-more', t('action_more'), 'more', attrs, { focus: 'sd:more' }) : '';
            const meta = [detail ? detail.dir : '', detail ? ageText(detail.created, snap.now) : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
            const tabs = sm.STACK_TABS.map(tab => '<button type="button" role="tab" class="dm-tab" id="' + uid + '-stab-' + tab + '" data-action="stack-tab" data-tab="' + tab + '" data-focus-id="stab:' + tab + '" aria-selected="' + (stack.tab === tab)
                + '" aria-controls="' + uid + '-spanel-' + tab + '" tabindex="' + (stack.tab === tab ? '0' : '-1') + '">' + esc(t('stab_' + tab)) + (snap.dirty[tab] ? '<span class="dm-dirty" aria-hidden="true">●</span><span class="dm-sr-only">' + esc(t('unsaved')) + '</span>' : '') + '</button>').join('');
            return '<header class="dm-sd-head"><div class="dm-sd-title">' + dot(busy ? 'info' : tone) + '<h2 id="' + uid + '-stack-title">' + esc(stack.name) + '</h2>' + chip(host.name, model.colorOf(host.color))
                + '<span class="dm-sd-status">' + esc(statusText(summary)) + '</span>' + opBadge(op && op.op) + '</div>'
                + '<div class="dm-sd-actions">' + buttons + iconButton('close-stack', t('drawer_close'), 'close', '', { focus: 'sd:close' }) + '</div>'
                + (meta ? '<p class="dm-sd-meta" title="' + esc(meta) + '">' + esc(meta) + '</p>' : '') + '</header>'
                + '<div class="dm-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="' + esc(t('tabs_label')) + '">' + tabs + '</div>';
        }

        // The panels the editors live in. Rendered once per opened stack; docker-manager-editor.js fills the surfaces and
        // keeps the toolbars (Save, Save and deploy) in step with the drafts.
        function shell(stack) {
            const bar = file => '<div class="dm-ed-bar"><span class="dm-ed-file">' + esc(FILE_NAMES[file]) + '</span><span class="dm-ed-state" data-ed-state="' + file + '" role="status"></span><span class="dm-spacer"></span>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn" data-action="save-file" data-file="' + file + '" data-focus-id="save:' + file + '" disabled><span>' + esc(t('editor_save')) + '</span></button>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn is-primary" data-action="save-deploy" data-file="' + file + '" data-focus-id="savedeploy:' + file + '" disabled>' + glyph('deploy') + '<span>' + esc(t('editor_save_deploy')) + '</span></button></div>';
            const panel = (tab, inner, hidden) => '<div role="tabpanel" class="dm-sd-panel" id="' + uid + '-spanel-' + tab + '" aria-labelledby="' + uid + '-stab-' + tab + '" data-panel="' + tab + '"' + (hidden ? ' hidden' : '') + '>' + inner + '</div>';
            return panel('overview', '<div class="dm-sd-overview" data-stack-overview></div>', stack.tab !== 'overview')
                + panel('compose', bar('compose') + '<div class="dm-ed-surface" data-ed-surface="compose"></div>', stack.tab !== 'compose')
                + panel('env', '<p class="dm-hint dm-env-note" data-env-note></p>' + bar('env') + '<div class="dm-ed-surface" data-ed-surface="env"></div>', stack.tab !== 'env');
        }

        // Loading, failed or vanished stack: the pane says so instead of the shell.
        function problem(snap) {
            const stack = snap.state.stack;
            if (!stack || stack.status === 'ok') return '';
            const head2 = '<header class="dm-sd-head"><div class="dm-sd-title"><h2 id="' + uid + '-stack-title">' + esc(stack.name) + '</h2></div><div class="dm-sd-actions">' + iconButton('close-stack', t('drawer_close'), 'close', '', { focus: 'sd:close' }) + '</div></header>';
            if (stack.status === 'loading') return head2 + spinner();
            const gone = stack.error && stack.error.code === 'stack_not_found';
            return head2 + '<div class="dm-empty-inner"><p class="dm-error" role="alert">' + esc(gone ? t('stack_gone') : t('stack_load_failed') + ' ' + views.errorText(stack.error)) + '</p>'
                + (gone ? '' : button('retry-stack', t('banner_retry'), { glyph: 'refresh' })) + '</div>';
        }

        return { list, head, shell, overview, problem, statusText, ageText };
    }

    window.DockerManagerStacks = { create, FILE_NAMES };
})();
```

Create `disposable\dm2-i18n\merge-docker-manager-stacks-i18n.mjs` (never committed; the later tasks use it again):

```js
// One-off helper, not committed: appends the phase 2 docker_manager.* keys to the sixteen ui/lang/desktop/<lang>.json files.
// Usage: node merge-docker-manager-stacks-i18n.mjs <repo-root> <rows-a.mjs> [<rows-b.mjs> ...]
// Every row is [key, en, de, es, fr, it, nl, pt, pl, sv, da, no, cs, el, hi, ja, zh]. A row with another number of texts, a text
// whose {{placeholders}} differ from the English one, a key that exists already or a key listed twice stops the script before
// anything is written.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const LANGS = ['en', 'de', 'es', 'fr', 'it', 'nl', 'pt', 'pl', 'sv', 'da', 'no', 'cs', 'el', 'hi', 'ja', 'zh'];
const [root, ...sources] = process.argv.slice(2);
const placeholders = text => [...String(text).matchAll(/\{\{(\w+)\}\}/g)].map(match => match[1]).sort().join(',');

const rows = [];
for (const source of sources) rows.push(...(await import(pathToFileURL(path.resolve(source)).href)).ROWS);

const problems = [], seen = new Set();
const dir = path.join(root, 'ui', 'lang', 'desktop');
const existing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'en.json'), 'utf8'));
for (const row of rows) {
    const [key, ...texts] = row;
    if (texts.length !== LANGS.length) { problems.push(key + ': ' + texts.length + ' texts, want ' + LANGS.length); continue; }
    if (seen.has(key)) problems.push(key + ': listed twice');
    seen.add(key);
    if (key in existing) problems.push(key + ': exists already');
    texts.forEach((text, index) => {
        if (!String(text).trim()) problems.push(key + ' [' + LANGS[index] + ']: empty');
        if (placeholders(text) !== placeholders(texts[0])) problems.push(key + ' [' + LANGS[index] + ']: placeholders differ from English');
    });
}
if (problems.length) { console.error(problems.join('\n')); process.exit(1); }

LANGS.forEach((lang, index) => {
    const file = path.join(dir, lang + '.json');
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    const eol = raw.includes('\r\n') ? '\r\n' : '\n';
    const body = raw.replace(/\s+$/, '');
    if (!body.endsWith('}')) throw new Error(file + ' does not end with }');
    const lines = rows.map(([key, ...texts]) => '  ' + JSON.stringify(key) + ': ' + JSON.stringify(texts[index]));
    const out = body.slice(0, -1).replace(/\s+$/, '') + ',' + eol + lines.join(',' + eol) + eol + '}' + eol;
    JSON.parse(out);
    fs.writeFileSync(file, out);
});
console.log('appended ' + rows.length + ' keys to ' + LANGS.length + ' files');
```

```js
// Rows: key, then en, de, es, fr, it, nl, pt, pl, sv, da, no, cs, el, hi, ja, zh.
```

### Task D6: The editor (CodeMirror YAML, lint gutter, plain-textarea fallback, workbench)

**Files:**

- Modify (test): `scripts/test-docker-manager-ui.mjs`
- Modify (test): `ui/i18n_lint_test.go`
- Create: `ui/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-editor.js`
- Modify: `ui/lang/desktop/{cs,da,de,el,en,es,fr,hi,it,ja,nl,no,pl,pt,sv,zh}.json` (32 keys)

`mount(host, options)` shows a plain textarea at once, loads CodeMirror in the background (a dynamic `import()` of the shared bundle, like Code Studio) and swaps it in; when the bundle cannot load the textarea stays. Both have Ctrl/Cmd+S and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, the diagnostics as a list below the editor (and as gutter marks in CodeMirror) and a way to mark the line an operation failed on. `createLinter` debounces the lint requests (400 ms) and drops the answer of a request that a newer one replaced. `createWorkbench` keeps the drafts of the compose file and the `.env` of the open stack while the tabs switch, saves them with the revision they are based on, resolves a revision conflict through the dialogs (`confirmConflict`, added in Task D9) and feeds the lint answer to the editors. The CodeMirror behaviour itself is exercised by the browser smoke in Task D12.

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `ui/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-editor.js`.**

```js
/* Docker Manager editor: the YAML/.env editor and the workbench of the open stack. A classic script
   (window.DockerManagerEditor) with no DOM work at load.
   - mount(host, options) shows a plain textarea at once, loads CodeMirror (the shared vendored ESM bundle, a dynamic import
     like Code Studio) in the background and swaps it in; when the bundle cannot load, the textarea stays. Both have Ctrl/Cmd+S
     (save) and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter (save and deploy), the lint diagnostics as gutter marks (CodeMirror) and as a list below the
     editor (always), and a way to mark the line an operation failed on.
   - createLinter debounces the lint requests (400 ms) and drops the answer of a request that a newer one replaced.
   - createWorkbench keeps the drafts of the compose file and the .env of the open stack while the tabs switch, saves them with
     the revision they are based on, resolves a revision conflict through the dialogs and feeds the diagnostics to the editors. */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    const CODEMIRROR_URL = '/js/vendor/codemirror-bundle.esm.js';
    const LINT_DELAY_MS = 400;
    const PROBLEMS_SHOWN = 8;
    const FILES = ['compose', 'env'];
    const SEVERITY_TONE = { error: 'bad', warning: 'warn', hint: 'info' };
    let codeMirrorPromise = null;

    function loadCodeMirror() {
        if (!codeMirrorPromise) {
            codeMirrorPromise = import(CODEMIRROR_URL).catch(error => {
                codeMirrorPromise = null;
                throw error;
            });
        }
        return codeMirrorPromise;
    }

    // Same rule as Code Studio: the scheme of the desktop theme decides between the light and the dark syntax palette.
    function usesLightEditorTheme() {
        const body = document.body;
        if (!body) return false;
        if (body.dataset.scheme) return body.dataset.scheme === 'light';
        if (body.dataset.theme === 'fruity') return body.dataset.fruityMode !== 'dark';
        return body.dataset.theme === 'light';
    }

    // source() returns a promise of the lint answer; deliver(result) gets it, deliver(null, error) a failure. The newest
    // request wins: an answer that arrives after a newer schedule()/flush() is dropped, aborted requests are silent.
    function createLinter(source, deliver, delay) {
        let timer = 0, sequence = 0, disposed = false;
        async function run() {
            timer = 0;
            const mine = ++sequence;
            try {
                const result = await source();
                if (!disposed && mine === sequence) deliver(result);
            } catch (error) {
                if (disposed || mine !== sequence || (error && error.dm && error.dm.code === 'aborted')) return;
                deliver(null, error);
            }
        }
        return {
            schedule() { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(run, delay == null ? LINT_DELAY_MS : delay); },
            flush() { clearTimeout(timer); return run(); },
            cancel() { clearTimeout(timer); timer = 0; sequence += 1; },
            dispose() { disposed = true; clearTimeout(timer); timer = 0; }
        };
    }

    function create(deps) {
        const { t, esc, stackModel: sm, views, uid } = deps;
        const load = deps.load || loadCodeMirror;
        let counter = 0;

        // options: {label, text, language: 'yaml'|'plain', readOnly, wrap, onChange(text), onSave(), onDeploy(), onFix(diagnostic)}
        // Diagnostics given to setDiagnostics are {line, column, severity, code, message, fix?}; message is already localized.
        function mount(host, options) {
            const o = options || {}, id = uid + '-ed' + (counter += 1), ac = new AbortController(), signal = ac.signal;
            const wrap = document.createElement('div'), area = document.createElement('div'), problems = document.createElement('div'), hint = document.createElement('p');
            wrap.className = 'dm-ed-wrap';
            area.className = 'dm-ed-area';
            problems.className = 'dm-ed-problems';
            problems.dataset.edProblems = '';
            hint.className = 'dm-hint dm-ed-hint';
            hint.id = id + '-hint';
            hint.textContent = t('editor_tab_hint');
            wrap.append(area, problems, hint);
            host.replaceChildren(wrap);
            const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
            textarea.className = 'dm-ed-text';
            textarea.spellcheck = false;
            textarea.setAttribute('autocapitalize', 'off');
            textarea.setAttribute('autocomplete', 'off');
            textarea.setAttribute('wrap', o.wrap ? 'soft' : 'off');
            textarea.setAttribute('aria-label', o.label || '');
            textarea.setAttribute('aria-describedby', hint.id);
            textarea.value = String(o.text == null ? '' : o.text);
            textarea.readOnly = !!o.readOnly;
            area.append(textarea);
            const handle = {};
            let view = null, cm = null, schemeSlot = null, readSlot = null, light = usesLightEditorTheme(), diagnostics = [], marks = [], applying = false, disposed = false, observer = null;

            const getText = () => (view ? view.state.doc.toString() : textarea.value);
            const changed = () => { if (!applying && !disposed && o.onChange) o.onChange(getText()); };

            // ---- problems list (CodeMirror and fallback alike) ---------------------------------------------------------
            function paintProblems() {
                const counts = sm.lintCounts(diagnostics);
                if (!diagnostics.length) { problems.innerHTML = ''; problems.hidden = true; return; }
                problems.hidden = false;
                const items = diagnostics.slice(0, PROBLEMS_SHOWN).map((d, index) => {
                    const fix = d.fix && d.fix.kind === 'env_random' && o.onFix
                        ? '<button type="button" class="dm-btn dm-problem-fix" data-fix="' + index + '"><span>' + esc(t('fix_env_random', { name: d.fix.variable })) + '</span></button>' : '';
                    return '<li class="dm-problem" data-severity="' + esc(d.severity) + '"><button type="button" class="dm-problem-go" data-line="' + (Number(d.line) || 0) + '" data-col="' + (Number(d.column) || 0) + '">'
                        + views.dot(SEVERITY_TONE[d.severity] || 'idle') + '<span class="dm-problem-sev">' + esc(t('lint_sev_' + d.severity)) + '</span>'
                        + (d.line ? '<span class="dm-problem-line">' + esc(t('lint_line', { line: d.line })) + '</span>' : '') + '<span class="dm-problem-text">' + esc(d.message) + '</span></button>' + fix + '</li>';
                }).join('');
                const more = diagnostics.length > PROBLEMS_SHOWN ? '<li class="dm-hint">' + esc(t('lint_more', { count: diagnostics.length - PROBLEMS_SHOWN })) + '</li>' : '';
                problems.innerHTML = '<p class="dm-problems-summary" role="status">' + esc(t('lint_summary', { errors: counts.error, warnings: counts.warning, hints: counts.hint })) + '</p><ul class="dm-problems-list">' + items + more + '</ul>';
            }
            problems.addEventListener('click', event => {
                const go = event.target.closest('[data-line]'), fix = event.target.closest('[data-fix]');
                if (go) handle.gotoLine(Number(go.dataset.line), Number(go.dataset.col));
                else if (fix && o.onFix) o.onFix(diagnostics[Number(fix.dataset.fix)]);
            }, { signal });

            // ---- diagnostics on the gutter (CodeMirror) ----------------------------------------------------------------
            function applyMarks() {
                if (!view) return;
                const doc = view.state.doc;
                const items = diagnostics.concat(marks).map(d => {
                    const line = doc.line(Math.min(Math.max(Number(d.line) || 1, 1), doc.lines));
                    const offset = Number(d.column) > 0 ? Number(d.column) - 1 : line.text.length - line.text.trimStart().length;
                    const from = Math.min(line.from + offset, line.to);
                    return { from, to: line.to, severity: d.severity === 'hint' ? 'info' : d.severity, message: d.message, source: d.code ? 'lint' : 'operation' };
                });
                view.dispatch(cm.setDiagnostics(view.state, items));
            }

            // ---- keyboard (textarea) -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            const shortcut = event => {
                if (!(event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) || event.altKey) return false;
                if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 's' && !event.shiftKey) { event.preventDefault(); if (o.onSave) o.onSave(); return true; }
                if (event.key === 'Enter') { event.preventDefault(); if (o.onDeploy) o.onDeploy(); return true; }
                return false;
            };
            textarea.addEventListener('keydown', shortcut, { signal });
            textarea.addEventListener('input', changed, { signal });

            // ---- CodeMirror --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            function schemeExtensions() {
                const highlight = light ? (cm.syntaxHighlighting && cm.defaultHighlightStyle ? [cm.syntaxHighlighting(cm.defaultHighlightStyle)] : []) : (cm.oneDark ? [cm.oneDark] : []);
                return highlight;
            }
            function tokenTheme() {
                return cm.EditorView.theme({
                    '&': { height: '100%', fontSize: '13px', backgroundColor: 'var(--vd-theme-app-bg)', color: 'var(--vd-text)' },
                    '.cm-scroller': { fontFamily: 'var(--ds-font-mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace)', lineHeight: '1.5' },
                    '.cm-content': { caretColor: 'var(--vd-accent)' },
                    '.cm-cursor': { borderLeftColor: 'var(--vd-accent)', borderLeftWidth: '2px' },
                    '.cm-gutters': { backgroundColor: 'var(--vd-theme-panel-bg)', color: 'var(--vd-theme-muted)', borderRight: '1px solid var(--vd-theme-border)' },
                    '.cm-activeLine': { backgroundColor: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--vd-accent) 8%, transparent)' },
                    '.cm-activeLineGutter': { backgroundColor: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--vd-accent) 12%, transparent)' },
                    '&.cm-focused': { outline: 'var(--ds-focus-ring-width) solid var(--ds-color-border-focus)', outlineOffset: '-2px' },
                    '.cm-tooltip': { backgroundColor: 'var(--vd-theme-panel-bg-strong)', color: 'var(--vd-text)', border: '1px solid var(--vd-theme-border)' }
                }, { dark: !light });
            }
            function readExtensions(readOnly) { return [cm.EditorState.readOnly.of(!!readOnly), cm.EditorView.editable.of(!readOnly)]; }
            function swapToCodeMirror(module) {
                if (disposed) return;
                cm = module;
                const wasFocused = document.activeElement === textarea, caret = textarea.selectionStart || 0;
                schemeSlot = new cm.Compartment();
                readSlot = new cm.Compartment();
                const keys = [
                    { key: 'Mod-s', preventDefault: true, run: () => { if (o.onSave) o.onSave(); return true; } },
                    { key: 'Mod-Enter', preventDefault: true, run: () => { if (o.onDeploy) o.onDeploy(); return true; } },
                    cm.indentWithTab, ...(cm.closeBracketsKeymap || []), ...(cm.defaultKeymap || []), ...(cm.searchKeymap || []), ...(cm.historyKeymap || []), ...(cm.lintKeymap || [])
                ].filter(Boolean);
                const extensions = [
                    cm.lineNumbers(), cm.highlightActiveLineGutter(), cm.highlightSpecialChars(), cm.history(), cm.drawSelection(), cm.dropCursor(), cm.highlightActiveLine(),
                    cm.indentUnit.of('  '), cm.EditorState.tabSize.of(2), cm.closeBrackets(), cm.highlightSelectionMatches(),
                    o.language === 'yaml' ? cm.yaml() : [], o.wrap ? cm.EditorView.lineWrapping : [],
                    cm.lintGutter(), cm.linter(null), schemeSlot.of(schemeExtensions()), tokenTheme(), readSlot.of(readExtensions(o.readOnly)),
                    cm.EditorView.contentAttributes.of({ 'aria-label': o.label || '', 'aria-describedby': hint.id }),
                    cm.keymap.of(keys),
                    cm.EditorView.updateListener.of(update => {
                        if (!update.docChanged || applying) return;
                        if (marks.length) { marks = []; applyMarks(); }
                        changed();
                    })
                ];
                const cmHost = document.createElement('div');
                cmHost.className = 'dm-ed-cm';
                area.append(cmHost);
                view = new cm.EditorView({ state: cm.EditorState.create({ doc: textarea.value, extensions }), parent: cmHost });
                textarea.hidden = true;
                handle.kind = 'codemirror';
                applyMarks();
                if (wasFocused) { view.focus(); view.dispatch({ selection: { anchor: Math.min(caret, view.state.doc.length) } }); }
                if (typeof MutationObserver === 'function' && document.body) {
                    observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
                        const next = usesLightEditorTheme();
                        if (next === light || !view) return;
                        light = next;
                        view.dispatch({ effects: schemeSlot.reconfigure(schemeExtensions()) });
                    });
                    observer.observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-theme', 'data-fruity-mode', 'data-scheme'] });
                }
            }

            Object.assign(handle, {
                kind: 'textarea',
                getText,
                setText(next) {
                    const value = String(next == null ? '' : next);
                    applying = true;
                    try {
                        if (view) view.dispatch({ changes: { from: 0, to: view.state.doc.length, insert: value } });
                        else textarea.value = value;
                    } finally { applying = false; }
                    if (marks.length) { marks = []; applyMarks(); }
                },
                focus() { if (view) view.focus(); else textarea.focus(); },
                // Moves the caret to a line (1-based) and scrolls it into view.
                gotoLine(line, column) {
                    if (view) {
                        const doc = view.state.doc, found = doc.line(Math.min(Math.max(Number(line) || 1, 1), doc.lines));
                        const pos = Math.min(found.from + Math.max(0, (Number(column) || 1) - 1), found.to);
                        view.dispatch({ selection: { anchor: pos }, effects: cm.EditorView.scrollIntoView(pos, { y: 'center' }) });
                        view.focus();
                    } else {
                        const range = sm.lineRange(sm.lineIndex(textarea.value), line, column);
                        textarea.focus();
                        textarea.setSelectionRange(range.from, range.to);
                    }
                },
                setDiagnostics(list) { diagnostics = Array.isArray(list) ? list : []; paintProblems(); applyMarks(); },
                // The line an operation failed on: an error mark (and a list entry) until the text changes.
                markLine(line, message) {
                    marks = [{ line: Number(line) || 1, severity: 'error', message: String(message || '') }];
                    applyMarks();
                    handle.gotoLine(line);
                },
                setReadOnly(readOnly) {
                    if (!!o.readOnly === !!readOnly) return;
                    o.readOnly = !!readOnly;
                    textarea.readOnly = !!readOnly;
                    if (view) view.dispatch({ effects: readSlot.reconfigure(readExtensions(readOnly)) });
                },
                refresh() { if (view) view.requestMeasure(); },
                dispose() {
                    if (disposed) return;
                    disposed = true;
                    ac.abort();
                    observer?.disconnect();
                    view?.destroy();
                    view = null;
                    host.replaceChildren();
                }
            });
            handle.ready = load().then(swapToCodeMirror, error => {
                console.warn('Docker Manager: CodeMirror failed to load, using a plain text area', error);
            });
            paintProblems();
            return handle;
        }

        // ---- the workbench of the open stack -------------------------------------------------------------------------

        // w = {store, dialogs, toast, announce, canMutate(), onChange(), onDeploy(), onGoto(file)}. One workbench lives while a
        // stack is open; open(pane, stack) binds it to the pane built by Stacks.shell().
        function createWorkbench(w) {
            let pane = null, key = '', ids = { hostId: '', name: '' }, linter = null, saving = false, disposed = false;
            const drafts = {}, editors = {};
            const baseOf = file => ({ content: String(file && file.content || ''), revision: String(file && file.revision || ''), exists: !!(file && file.exists) });
            const detailOf = () => {
                const stack = w.store.state.stack;
                return stack && stack.key === key && stack.detail ? stack.detail : null;
            };
            const dirty = file => {
                const d = drafts[file];
                return !!d && d.text !== d.base.content;
            };
            const anyDirty = () => FILES.some(dirty);
            const q = selector => (pane ? pane.querySelector(selector) : null);
            const messageOf = (d, text) => Object.assign({}, d, { message: text });

            // Localizes the lint answer and hands every editor the diagnostics of its file.
            function deliver(result) {
                if (disposed || !result) return;
                const split = sm.splitDiagnostics(result.diagnostics);
                for (const file of FILES) {
                    if (editors[file]) editors[file].setDiagnostics(split[file].map(d => messageOf(d, sm.diagnosticText(d, t))));
                }
            }
            function lintSource() {
                return w.store.lint(ids.hostId, { compose: drafts.compose ? drafts.compose.text : '', env: drafts.env ? drafts.env.text : '', stack: ids.name }, 'stack');
            }

            function paintState() {
                const can = w.canMutate();
                for (const file of FILES) {
                    const d = drafts[file], isDirty = dirty(file);
                    const state = q('[data-ed-state="' + file + '"]');
                    if (state) state.textContent = !d ? '' : d.stale ? t('editor_stale') : isDirty ? t('editor_unsaved') : t('editor_saved');
                    for (const button of pane ? pane.querySelectorAll('[data-file="' + file + '"]') : []) {
                        button.hidden = !can;
                        button.disabled = saving || !can || (button.dataset.action === 'save-file' ? !isDirty : false);
                    }
                    if (editors[file]) editors[file].setReadOnly(!can);
                }
                const note = q('[data-env-note]'), detail = detailOf();
                if (note) note.textContent = detail && !detail.env.exists ? t('env_missing_note') : '';
            }

            function ensureEditor(file) {
                if (editors[file] || !pane || !drafts[file]) return;
                const surface = q('[data-ed-surface="' + file + '"]');
                if (!surface) return;
                editors[file] = mount(surface, {
                    label: file === 'compose' ? t('editor_compose_label') : t('editor_env_label'), text: drafts[file].text, language: file === 'compose' ? 'yaml' : 'plain', wrap: file === 'env',
                    readOnly: !w.canMutate(),
                    onChange: text => { drafts[file].text = text; if (linter) linter.schedule(); paintState(); w.onChange(); },
                    onSave: () => { void save([file], false); },
                    onDeploy: () => { void save(FILES.filter(dirty), true); },
                    onFix: file === 'compose' ? diagnostic => fixVariable(diagnostic) : undefined
                });
                if (linter) linter.flush();
            }

            function fixVariable(diagnostic) {
                const name = diagnostic && diagnostic.fix && diagnostic.fix.variable;
                if (!name || !drafts.env || !w.canMutate()) return;
                const next = sm.appendEnvVariable(drafts.env.text, name, sm.randomValue(32, window.crypto));
                if (next === drafts.env.text) return;
                drafts.env.text = next;
                if (editors.env) editors.env.setText(next);
                if (linter) linter.schedule();
                paintState();
                w.onChange();
                w.announce(t('fix_env_done', { name }));
            }

            // Reads the stack as the store has it. A draft that equals the host's text is clean whatever the revision; a clean
            // draft follows a changed file; an edited draft whose file changed on the host is marked stale and meets the
            // revision conflict when it is saved.
            function sync() {
                const detail = detailOf();
                if (disposed || !detail) return;
                for (const file of FILES) {
                    const current = detail[file] || {}, d = drafts[file];
                    if (!d) { drafts[file] = { text: String(current.content || ''), base: baseOf(current), stale: false }; continue; }
                    if (d.text === String(current.content || '')) { d.base = baseOf(current); d.stale = false; }
                    else if (String(current.revision || '') !== d.base.revision) {
                        if (d.text === d.base.content) { d.base = baseOf(current); d.text = d.base.content; d.stale = false; if (editors[file]) editors[file].setText(d.text); }
                        else d.stale = true;
                    }
                }
                if (!linter) { linter = createLinter(lintSource, deliver); linter.flush(); }
                paintState();
            }

            // files: the file names to save together; deploy: run "up" after a successful save. Resolves true when everything
            // asked for is on the host (nothing dirty counts as saved).
            async function save(files, deploy) {
                if (saving || disposed || !w.canMutate()) return false;
                const names = files.filter(dirty);
                if (!names.length) { if (deploy) w.onDeploy(); return true; }
                saving = true;
                paintState();
                try {
                    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 4; attempt += 1) {
                        const payload = {};
                        for (const file of names) payload[file] = { content: drafts[file].text, revision: drafts[file].base.revision };
                        try {
                            const revisions = await w.store.saveFiles(ids.hostId, ids.name, payload);
                            if (disposed) return false;
                            for (const file of names) {
                                drafts[file].base = { content: payload[file].content, revision: String(revisions[file] || ''), exists: true };
                                drafts[file].stale = false;
                            }
                            w.toast(t('editor_saved_toast', { files: names.map(file => (file === 'env' ? '.env' : 'compose')).join(', ') }), 'success');
                            w.announce(t('editor_saved'));
                            if (deploy) w.onDeploy();
                            return true;
                        } catch (error) {
                            const info = (error && error.dm) || {};
                            if (info.code !== 'revision_conflict' || !info.data || !info.data.current) { w.toast(views.errorText(info), 'error'); return false; }
                            const file = FILES.includes(info.data.file) ? info.data.file : names[0], current = info.data.current;
                            const choice = await w.dialogs.confirmConflict({ file, mine: drafts[file].text, theirs: String(current.content || ''), name: file === 'env' ? '.env' : String(current.name || 'compose.yaml') });
                            if (disposed) return false;
                            if (choice === 'theirs') {
                                drafts[file].base = baseOf(current);
                                drafts[file].text = drafts[file].base.content;
                                drafts[file].stale = false;
                                if (editors[file]) editors[file].setText(drafts[file].text);
                                return false;
                            }
                            if (choice !== 'mine') return false;
                            drafts[file].base = { content: String(current.content || ''), revision: String(current.revision || ''), exists: !!current.exists };
                        }
                    }
                    return false;
                } finally {
                    saving = false;
                    if (!disposed) { paintState(); w.onChange(); }
                }
            }

            return {
                // Binds to the pane of a stack; the first sync() fills the drafts.
                open(element, stack) {
                    this.close();
                    pane = element;
                    key = stack.key;
                    ids = { hostId: stack.hostId, name: stack.name };
                    disposed = false;
                    sync();
                },
                close() {
                    disposed = true;
                    linter?.dispose();
                    linter = null;
                    for (const file of FILES) { editors[file]?.dispose(); delete editors[file]; delete drafts[file]; }
                    pane = null;
                    key = '';
                    saving = false;
                },
                sync,
                // Mounts the editor of a tab the first time it is shown (a hidden CodeMirror cannot measure itself).
                showTab(tab) {
                    if (!FILES.includes(tab)) return;
                    ensureEditor(tab);
                    editors[tab]?.refresh();
                    paintState();
                },
                focusEditor(tab) { editors[tab]?.focus(); },
                // An operation failed on a line of the compose file: show the Compose tab's editor with the line marked.
                markLine(line, message) { ensureEditor('compose'); editors.compose?.markLine(line, message); },
                dirty,
                anyDirty,
                dirtyState: () => ({ compose: dirty('compose'), env: dirty('env') }),
                save: (files, deploy) => save(files || FILES, !!deploy),
                isOpen: () => !!pane && !disposed,
                key: () => key
            };
        }

        return { mount, createWorkbench };
    }

    window.DockerManagerEditor = { create, createLinter, usesLightEditorTheme, LINT_DELAY_MS };
})();
```
