- [ ] **Step 3: Create `ui/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-ops.js`.**

```js
/* Docker Manager operations: the progress drawer at the bottom of the app and the commands that start an operation.
   A classic script (window.DockerManagerOps) with no DOM work at load.
   - html(snap) builds the drawer: a status line that is all there is while nothing runs, and when opened one entry per
     operation (started here or found running on the engine) with its state, the elapsed time, a progress bar per image
     that reported a total, the failure with its line, the health-wait warning, the published ports and the output with the
     terminal colour codes removed. Leaving a stack never cancels anything; the entries stay.
   - run/prepare start an operation through the store and open the drawer; a stack that is busy attaches to the running
     operation instead of failing; done() tells the user how an operation ended.
   - tick() keeps the elapsed times moving without repainting the drawer. */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    function create(deps) {
        const { t, esc, model, stackModel: sm, views, store, toast, announce, uid } = deps;
        const { glyph, dot, chip } = views;
        const toggled = new Set();
        let open = false, ticker = 0;

        const titleOf = (kind, stack) => (stack ? t('op_title', { kind: t('op_kind_' + kind), stack }) : t('op_kind_' + kind));
        const entryTitle = op => titleOf(op.kind, op.stack);
        const stateText = op => t('op_state_' + (sm.OP_STATES.includes(op.state) ? op.state : 'failed'));
        const defaultOutput = entry => sm.isActiveOp(entry.op) || entry.op.state === 'failed' || entry.op.state === 'interrupted';
        const outputOpen = entry => (toggled.has(entry.id) ? !defaultOutput(entry) : defaultOutput(entry));

        function line(snap) {
            const entries = snap.state.ops, active = entries.filter(entry => sm.isActiveOp(entry.op));
            if (active.length) {
                const first = active[0];
                const more = active.length > 1 ? ' ' + t('ops_more', { count: active.length - 1 }) : '';
                return { tone: 'info', busy: true, text: entryTitle(first.op) + ' · ' + stateText(first.op) + more, entry: first };
            }
            if (entries.length) {
                const last = entries[0];
                return { tone: sm.OP_TONE[last.op.state] || 'idle', busy: false, text: entryTitle(last.op) + ' · ' + stateText(last.op), entry: last };
            }
            return { tone: 'idle', busy: false, text: t('ops_idle'), entry: null };
        }

        function bars(entry) {
            const items = sm.progressBars(entry);
            if (!items.length) return '';
            return '<ul class="dm-bars" aria-label="' + esc(t('ops_progress')) + '">' + items.map(item => '<li class="dm-bar"><span class="dm-bar-label" title="' + esc(item.id) + '">' + esc(item.id) + '</span>'
                + '<progress class="dm-progress" max="100" value="' + Math.round(item.percent) + '" aria-label="' + esc(item.id) + '"></progress><span class="dm-bar-pct">' + Math.round(item.percent) + '%</span></li>').join('') + '</ul>';
        }

        function entryHtml(snap, entry) {
            const op = entry.op, active = sm.isActiveOp(op), tone = sm.OP_TONE[op.state] || 'idle';
            const host = snap.hosts.find(item => item.id === op.host_id);
            const out = views.stripAnsi(entry.output), shown = outputOpen(entry);
            const parts = ['<div class="dm-op-head">' + dot(tone) + '<strong class="dm-op-title">' + esc(entryTitle(op)) + '</strong>' + (host && snap.multi ? chip(host.name, model.colorOf(host.color)) : '')
                + '<span class="dm-op-state">' + esc(stateText(op)) + '</span><span class="dm-op-time" data-elapsed="' + esc(entry.id) + '">' + esc(sm.elapsed(op, snap.now)) + '</span><span class="dm-spacer"></span>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn" data-action="op-output" data-op-id="' + esc(entry.id) + '" data-focus-id="opout:' + esc(entry.id) + '" aria-expanded="' + shown + '"><span>' + esc(shown ? t('ops_hide_output') : t('ops_show_output')) + '</span></button></div>'];
            const barsHtml = bars(entry);
            if (barsHtml) parts.push(barsHtml);
            if (op.error) {
                const jump = op.error_line > 0 && op.stack
                    ? ' <button type="button" class="dm-btn" data-action="op-goto-line" data-op-id="' + esc(entry.id) + '" data-focus-id="opline:' + esc(entry.id) + '"><span>' + esc(t('ops_show_line', { line: op.error_line })) + '</span></button>' : '';
                parts.push('<p class="dm-op-error" role="alert">' + esc(op.error) + jump + '</p>');
            }
            if (op.warning) parts.push('<p class="dm-op-warning">' + glyph('warning') + '<span>' + esc(op.warning) + '</span></p>');
            const links = op.state === 'succeeded' && Array.isArray(op.ports) ? sm.portLinks(op.ports, sm.linkAddress(host, snap.pageHost)).filter(link => link.url) : [];
            if (links.length) parts.push('<p class="dm-op-ports">' + esc(t('ops_ports')) + ' ' + links.map(link => '<a class="dm-portlink" href="' + esc(link.url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">' + esc(link.label) + '</a>').join('') + '</p>');
            if (shown) parts.push('<pre class="dm-log dm-op-output" tabindex="0" data-op-output="' + esc(entry.id) + '" aria-label="' + esc(t('ops_output_label', { title: entryTitle(op) })) + '">' + esc(out || t('ops_no_output')) + '</pre>');
            return '<li class="dm-op" data-state="' + esc(op.state) + '" data-op-id="' + esc(entry.id) + '"' + (active ? ' aria-busy="true"' : '') + '>' + parts.join('') + '</li>';
        }

        // The whole drawer. `open` only decides whether the body shows; the bar is always there.
        function html(snap) {
            const status = line(snap), entries = snap.state.ops;
            const body = entries.length ? '<ul class="dm-oplist">' + entries.map(entry => entryHtml(snap, entry)).join('') + '</ul>' : '<p class="dm-muted dm-ops-empty">' + esc(t('ops_empty')) + '</p>';
            return '<button type="button" class="dm-ops-bar" data-action="ops-toggle" data-focus-id="ops:toggle" aria-expanded="' + open + '" aria-controls="' + uid + '-ops-body">'
                + (status.busy ? '<span class="dm-spinner is-small" aria-hidden="true"></span>' : dot(status.tone)) + '<span class="dm-ops-line" data-tone="' + status.tone + '">' + esc(status.text) + '</span>'
                + (status.entry && sm.isActiveOp(status.entry.op) ? '<span class="dm-op-time" data-elapsed="' + esc(status.entry.id) + '">' + esc(sm.elapsed(status.entry.op, snap.now)) + '</span>' : '')
                + '<span class="dm-spacer"></span><span class="dm-sr-only">' + esc(open ? t('ops_collapse') : t('ops_expand')) + '</span>' + glyph('chevron', 'dm-ops-chevron') + '</button>'
                + '<div class="dm-ops-body" id="' + uid + '-ops-body"' + (open ? '' : ' hidden') + '>' + body + '</div>';
        }

        const isOpen = () => open;
        function setOpen(next) { open = !!next; }
        function toggleOutput(id) { if (toggled.has(id)) toggled.delete(id); else toggled.add(id); }

        // Updates the elapsed times in place (once a second while something runs); returns whether anything is still running.
        function tick(container) {
            const now = Date.now();
            for (const el of container.querySelectorAll('[data-elapsed]')) {
                const entry = store.state.ops.find(item => item.id === el.dataset.elapsed);
                if (entry && sm.isActiveOp(entry.op)) el.textContent = sm.elapsed(entry.op, now);
            }
            return store.state.ops.some(entry => sm.isActiveOp(entry.op));
        }
        function startTicker(container) {
            if (ticker) return;
            ticker = setInterval(() => { if (!tick(container)) stopTicker(); }, 1000);
        }
        function stopTicker() { clearInterval(ticker); ticker = 0; }

        // ---- starting operations ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        // Starts an operation and opens the drawer. A busy stack is not an error: the running operation is attached.
        async function report(result, label) {
            if (result.ok) { open = true; announce(t('op_started', { title: label })); return result; }
            const error = result.error || {};
            if (error.code === 'aborted') return result;
            if (result.busy) { open = true; toast(t('op_busy', { title: label }), 'info'); return result; }
            toast(t('op_start_failed', { title: label, message: views.errorText(error) }), 'error');
            return result;
        }
        async function run(hostId, name, kind, options) {
            return report(await store.startOp(hostId, name, kind, options), titleOf(kind, name));
        }
        async function prepare(hostId) {
            return report(await store.prepareHost(hostId), titleOf('prepare', ''));
        }
        async function remove(hostId, name, volumes) {
            return report(await store.deleteStack(hostId, name, volumes), titleOf('delete', name));
        }

        // How an operation ended, for the toast and the live region. The drawer already shows the details.
        function done(entry) {
            const op = entry.op, title = entryTitle(op);
            if (op.state === 'succeeded') {
                const text = op.warning ? t('op_done_warning', { title, warning: op.warning }) : t('op_done', { title });
                toast(text, op.warning ? 'info' : 'success');
                announce(text);
            } else {
                const text = t('op_failed', { title, message: op.error || stateText(op) });
                open = true;
                toast(text, 'error');
                announce(text);
            }
        }

        return { html, isOpen, setOpen, toggleOutput, tick, startTicker, stopTicker, run, prepare, remove, done, entryTitle };
    }

    window.DockerManagerOps = { create };
})();
```

Ctrl/Cmd+K (or the toolbar button) opens a combobox with a listbox of the commands of the moment (`stackModel.paletteItems`): open a stack, deploy/update/restart/stop it, new stack on a host, switch to a host, prepare a host. Typing narrows the list, arrow keys move, Enter runs, Escape closes, Tab stays inside. The palette is not a native dialog and does not decide what a command does: the composition root (Task D12) passes the runner. The Node test covers the ranking (Task D3) and, here, the load contract (the module publishes its global, stays under 1100 lines, touches no DOM at load); the keyboard behaviour is in the browser smoke of Task D12.

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `ui/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-palette.js`.**

```js
/* Docker Manager command palette: Ctrl/Cmd+K (or the toolbar button) opens a list of commands built from the current
   data: open a stack, deploy/update/restart/stop it, new stack on a host, switch to a host, prepare a host. Typing narrows
   the list (every word must match, a hit at the start of a word ranks higher); arrow keys move, Enter runs, Escape closes.
   A classic script (window.DockerManagerPalette) with no DOM work at load. The palette is a combobox with a listbox
   (aria-activedescendant), not a native dialog, so it sits inside the app; docker-manager.js decides what a command does
   and refuses to open the palette while a dialog is open. */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    function create(deps) {
        const { t, esc, stackModel: sm, views, root, uid } = deps;
        const listId = uid + '-palette-list';
        let panel = null, input = null, listEl = null, liveEl = null, items = [], results = [], index = 0, returnFocus = null, onRun = null;

        const isOpen = () => !!panel;
        const optionId = i => uid + '-palette-opt-' + i;

        function render() {
            const query = input.value;
            results = sm.rankItems(items, query, 40);
            index = Math.min(index, Math.max(0, results.length - 1));
            listEl.innerHTML = results.length ? results.map((item, i) => '<li class="dm-palette-item" role="option" id="' + optionId(i) + '" data-index="' + i + '" aria-selected="' + (i === index) + '">'
                + sm.highlight(item.label, query).map(part => (part.hit ? '<mark>' + esc(part.text) + '</mark>' : esc(part.text))).join('') + '</li>').join('')
                : '<li class="dm-palette-empty" role="presentation">' + esc(t('palette_empty')) + '</li>';
            input.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', results.length ? optionId(index) : '');
            liveEl.textContent = results.length ? t('palette_count', { count: results.length }) : t('palette_empty');
            listEl.querySelector('[aria-selected="true"]')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
        }

        function close() {
            if (!panel) return;
            const target = returnFocus;
            panel.remove();
            panel = input = listEl = liveEl = null;
            returnFocus = null;
            if (target && target.isConnected && typeof target.focus === 'function') target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }

        function run(item) {
            if (!item) return;
            close();
            if (onRun) onRun(item);
        }

        // getItems() returns the commands of the moment (stackModel.paletteItems); run(item) executes one.
        function open(getItems, runItem) {
            if (panel) return;
            items = getItems();
            onRun = runItem;
            index = 0;
            returnFocus = document.activeElement;
            panel = document.createElement('div');
            panel.className = 'dm-palette-backdrop';
            panel.dataset.palette = '';
            panel.innerHTML = '<div class="dm-palette" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="' + esc(t('palette_title')) + '">'
                + '<div class="dm-palette-input">' + views.glyph('command') + '<input type="text" class="dm-palette-field" role="combobox" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="' + listId + '" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-activedescendant=""'
                + ' autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" autocapitalize="off" placeholder="' + esc(t('palette_placeholder')) + '" aria-label="' + esc(t('palette_title')) + '"><kbd class="dm-kbd">Esc</kbd></div>'
                + '<ul class="dm-palette-list" role="listbox" id="' + listId + '" aria-label="' + esc(t('palette_title')) + '"></ul>'
                + '<div class="dm-sr-only" role="status" aria-live="polite" data-palette-live></div></div>';
            root.append(panel);
            input = panel.querySelector('input');
            listEl = panel.querySelector('[role="listbox"]');
            liveEl = panel.querySelector('[data-palette-live]');
            render();
            input.focus();
            input.addEventListener('input', () => { index = 0; render(); });
            panel.addEventListener('click', event => {
                const option = event.target.closest('[data-index]');
                if (option) { run(results[Number(option.dataset.index)]); return; }
                if (event.target === panel) close();
            });
            panel.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
                const mod = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
                if (mod && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); close(); return; }
                const last = results.length - 1;
                const to = { ArrowDown: index >= last ? 0 : index + 1, ArrowUp: index <= 0 ? last : index - 1, Home: 0, End: last }[event.key];
                if (to !== undefined) { event.preventDefault(); index = Math.max(0, to); render(); }
                else if (event.key === 'Enter') { event.preventDefault(); run(results[index]); }
                else if (event.key === 'Escape') { event.preventDefault(); close(); }
                else if (event.key === 'Tab') event.preventDefault();
                // Nothing typed into the palette reaches the keyboard handling of the app behind it.
                event.stopPropagation();
            });
        }

        return { open, close, isOpen, dispose: close };
    }

    window.DockerManagerPalette = { create };
})();
```

                        yes.removeAttribute('aria-busy');

                        box.addEventListener('change', () => { choice.volumes = box.checked; view.update(); });

                const view = {
                    title: t('down_volumes_title', { name: info.name }),
                    html: () => '<p class="dm-dialog-copy">' + esc(t('down_volumes_body', { name: info.name, host: info.hostName })) + '</p>'

                        + '<p class="dm-note">' + views.glyph('lock') + '<span>' + esc(t('down_volumes_stay', { path: info.dir })) + '</span></p>'
                        + actions('', button('no', dt('desktop.cancel'), { auto: true }) + button('retry', t('banner_retry'), { glyph: 'refresh' }) + button('yes', t('down_volumes_confirm'), { danger: true, disabled: true })),
                    update() {
                        refreshPart(view, '[data-volumes]', volumesHtml(data));
                        const yes = content.querySelector('[data-dact="yes"]'), retry = content.querySelector('[data-dact="retry"]');
                        if (yes) { yes.disabled = data.status !== 'ok'; yes.removeAttribute('aria-busy'); }
                        if (retry) retry.hidden = data.status !== 'error';
                    },
                    bind(c) {
                        c.querySelector('[data-dact="no"]').addEventListener('click', () => { settle(false); pop(false); });
                        c.querySelector('[data-dact="yes"]').addEventListener('click', () => { settle(true); pop(true); });
                        c.querySelector('[data-dact="retry"]').addEventListener('click', () => loadVolumes(info, data, view));
                        view.update();
                    },
                    onClose() { settle(false); }
                };
                push(view);
                loadVolumes(info, data, view);
            });
        }

        // The file changed on the host since it was loaded: a line diff from the host version to yours. Resolves 'mine'

        function confirmConflict(info) {

                    bind(c) {

                        c.querySelector('[data-dact="mine"]').addEventListener('click', () => { settle('mine'); pop(true); });
                    },
                    onClose() { settle(null); }
                });
            });
        }

        // Preparing a host pulls the helper image (about 64 MB) and creates the IO container. Resolves true or false.
        function confirmPrepare(info) {

Files dropped on the window arrive through `acceptFiles`. Closing a filled view asks first (the composition root does the asking).

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `ui/js/desktop/apps/docker-manager-newstack.js`.**

```js
/* Docker Manager new stack: the flow that creates a stack. A classic script (window.DockerManagerNewStack) with no DOM
   work at load. It fills the content area of the window (the list and the stack pane step aside) with
   - the name (checked like dockerstacks.ValidateName) and the host (fixed when the window is scoped to one host, a picker
     under "All hosts"),
   - two sources: Paste (the compose editor itself, plus an optional .env) and Convert docker run (POST /convert/docker-run
     fills the editor and lists what could not be converted),
   - a live preview next to the code from POST /lint (400 ms after the last keystroke): services, ports with the
     containers that already use them, storage (volumes to create, host folders), variables with "Create random value in
     .env", and the lint hints,
   - Save draft (create) and Deploy (create with deploy: true; the operation shows in the progress drawer). A deploy that could
     not start answers 201 with deploy_error and no operation: the stack stays a draft and an error toast says why.
   Files dropped on the window (compose.yaml, docker-compose.yml, .env) arrive through acceptFiles(). */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    const MAX_FILE_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;

    function create(deps) {
        const { t, esc, model, stackModel: sm, views, editor, store, dialogs, toast, announce, uid, el } = deps;
        const fieldId = name => uid + '-ns-' + name;
        const s = { open: false, tab: 'paste', hostId: '', locked: false, busy: false, lint: null, lintFailed: null, warnings: [], nameTouched: false, initial: '' };
        let compose = null, env = null, linter = null, ac = null;

        const q = selector => el.querySelector(selector);
        const hostName = id => (store.state.hosts.find(host => host.id === id) || {}).name || id;
        const takenNames = () => {
            const entry = store.state.stacks[s.hostId], listing = entry && entry.listing;
            return listing ? listing.stacks.map(stack => stack.name) : [];
        };
        const nameValue = () => (q('[name="name"]') ? q('[name="name"]').value.trim() : '');
        const composeText = () => (compose ? compose.getText() : '');
        const envText = () => (env ? env.getText() : '');
        const snapshot = () => JSON.stringify([nameValue(), composeText(), envText(), q('[name="command"]') ? q('[name="command"]').value : '']);
        const isOpen = () => s.open;
        const isDirty = () => s.open && snapshot() !== s.initial;

        // ---- preview -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        function portLine(port) {
            const published = port.host ? port.host + '→' : '';
            const label = (port.host_ip ? port.host_ip + ':' : '') + published + port.container + '/' + (port.protocol || 'tcp');
            return '<li><code>' + esc(label) + '</code>' + (port.conflict ? '<span class="dm-badge" data-tone="warn">' + esc(t('preview_port_conflict', { container: port.conflict })) + '</span>' : '') + '</li>';
        }

        function previewHtml() {
            if (s.lintFailed) return '<p class="dm-muted" role="status">' + esc(t('preview_failed')) + ' ' + esc(views.errorText(s.lintFailed.dm || s.lintFailed)) + '</p>';
            const result = s.lint;
            if (!result) return '<p class="dm-muted" role="status">' + esc(composeText().trim() ? t('preview_checking') : t('preview_empty')) + '</p>';
            const preview = result.preview || {}, services = Array.isArray(preview.services) ? preview.services : [], diagnostics = sm.sortDiagnostics(result.diagnostics);
            const out = [];
            if (result.ports_unchecked) out.push('<p class="dm-note">' + views.glyph('warning') + '<span>' + esc(t('preview_ports_unchecked')) + '</span></p>');
            out.push('<section class="dm-pv"><h3>' + esc(t('preview_services')) + '<span class="dm-count">' + services.length + '</span></h3>'
                + (services.length ? '<ul class="dm-pv-list">' + services.map(service => '<li><strong>' + esc(service.name) + '</strong> <span class="dm-muted">' + esc(service.image || (service.build ? t('preview_build') : '')) + '</span>'
                    + (service.ports && service.ports.length ? '<ul class="dm-pv-ports">' + service.ports.map(portLine).join('') + '</ul>' : '') + '</li>').join('') + '</ul>' : '<p class="dm-muted">' + esc(t('preview_no_services')) + '</p>') + '</section>');
            const groups = sm.storageGroups(preview), named = Array.isArray(preview.named_volumes) ? preview.named_volumes : [];
            const storage = [];
            if (named.length) storage.push('<li><span class="dm-pv-kind">' + esc(t('preview_kind_named')) + '</span> ' + named.map(name => '<code>' + esc(name) + '</code>').join(' ') + '</li>');
            for (const kind of ['bind', 'relative', 'anonymous', 'tmpfs']) {
                for (const volume of groups[kind]) storage.push('<li><span class="dm-pv-kind">' + esc(t('preview_kind_' + kind)) + '</span> <code>' + esc(volume.source ? volume.source + ' → ' : '') + esc(volume.target) + '</code>' + (volume.readOnly ? ' <span class="dm-muted">' + esc(t('preview_read_only')) + '</span>' : '') + '</li>');
            }
            out.push('<section class="dm-pv"><h3>' + esc(t('preview_storage')) + '</h3>' + (storage.length ? '<ul class="dm-pv-list">' + storage.join('') + '</ul>' : '<p class="dm-muted">' + esc(t('preview_no_storage')) + '</p>') + '</section>');
            const variables = Array.isArray(preview.variables) ? preview.variables : [], fixable = new Set(sm.randomFixes(diagnostics));
            if (variables.length) {
                out.push('<section class="dm-pv"><h3>' + esc(t('preview_variables')) + '</h3><ul class="dm-pv-list">' + variables.map(variable => {
                    const state = sm.envHas(envText(), variable.name) || variable.in_env ? 'set' : variable.has_default ? 'default' : variable.required ? 'required' : 'missing';
                    const fix = fixable.has(variable.name) && state === 'missing' ? ' <button type="button" class="dm-btn" data-ns="random" data-variable="' + esc(variable.name) + '"><span>' + esc(t('fix_env_random', { name: variable.name })) + '</span></button>' : '';
                    return '<li><code>' + esc(variable.name) + '</code> <span class="dm-badge"' + (state === 'missing' || state === 'required' ? ' data-tone="warn"' : '') + '>' + esc(t('preview_var_' + state)) + '</span>' + fix + '</li>';
                }).join('') + '</ul></section>');
            }
            if (diagnostics.length) {
                out.push('<section class="dm-pv"><h3>' + esc(t('preview_hints')) + '<span class="dm-count">' + diagnostics.length + '</span></h3><ul class="dm-pv-list">' + diagnostics.map(d => '<li data-severity="' + esc(sm.severityOf(d)) + '">'
                    + views.dot(sm.severityOf(d) === 'error' ? 'bad' : sm.severityOf(d) === 'warning' ? 'warn' : 'info') + '<span class="dm-sr-only">' + esc(t('lint_sev_' + sm.severityOf(d))) + '</span> '
                    + (d.line ? '<span class="dm-muted">' + esc(t('lint_line', { line: d.line })) + '</span> ' : '') + esc(sm.diagnosticText(d, t)) + '</li>').join('') + '</ul></section>');
            }
            return out.join('');
        }
        function paintPreview() {
            const target = q('[data-ns-preview]');
            if (target) target.innerHTML = previewHtml();
        }

        function distribute(result) {
            const split = sm.splitDiagnostics(result.diagnostics);
            const localized = list => list.map(d => Object.assign({}, d, { message: sm.diagnosticText(d, t) }));
            if (compose) compose.setDiagnostics(localized(split.compose));
            if (env) env.setDiagnostics(localized(split.env));
        }

        // ---- the form ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        function nameProblem() {
            const problem = sm.validateName(nameValue(), takenNames());
            const hint = q('[data-ns-name-hint]'), input = q('[name="name"]');
            if (!hint || !input) return problem;
            const touched = s.nameTouched || nameValue() !== '';
            hint.textContent = problem && touched ? t('sv_name_' + problem.code) : t('ns_name_hint');
            hint.dataset.tone = problem && touched ? 'bad' : '';
            if (problem && touched) input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true'); else input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
            return problem;
        }

        function hostField() {
            const hosts = store.state.hosts;
            if (s.locked) return '<div class="dm-field"><span class="dm-label">' + esc(t('ns_host')) + '</span><div>' + views.chip(hostName(s.hostId), model.colorOf((hosts.find(host => host.id === s.hostId) || {}).color)) + '</div></div>';
            const options = hosts.map(host => {
                const state = sm.hostStacksState(store.state.stacks[host.id]);
                const note = state === 'not_prepared' ? ' (' + t('ns_host_unprepared') + ')' : state === 'api_too_old' ? ' (' + t('ns_host_old') + ')' : '';
                return '<option value="' + esc(host.id) + '"' + (host.id === s.hostId ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(host.name + note) + '</option>';
            }).join('');
            return '<div class="dm-field"><label for="' + fieldId('host') + '">' + esc(t('ns_host')) + '</label><select id="' + fieldId('host') + '" name="host">' + options + '</select></div>';
        }

        function markup() {
            const tab = (id, label) => '<button type="button" role="tab" class="dm-tab" id="' + fieldId('tab-' + id) + '" data-ns-tab="' + id + '" data-focus-id="nstab:' + id + '" aria-selected="' + (s.tab === id) + '" aria-controls="' + fieldId('panel-' + id) + '" tabindex="' + (s.tab === id ? '0' : '-1') + '">' + esc(label) + '</button>';
            return '<div class="dm-ns"><header class="dm-ns-head"><h2 id="' + fieldId('title') + '">' + esc(t('ns_title')) + '</h2><span class="dm-spacer"></span>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn" data-ns="cancel" data-focus-id="ns:cancel">' + esc(t('ns_cancel')) + '</button></header>'
                + '<div class="dm-ns-body"><section class="dm-ns-main" aria-labelledby="' + fieldId('title') + '"><div class="dm-ns-fields">'
                + '<div class="dm-field"><label for="' + fieldId('name') + '">' + esc(t('ns_name')) + '</label><input id="' + fieldId('name') + '" name="name" maxlength="63" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" autocapitalize="off" aria-describedby="' + fieldId('name-hint') + '" data-autofocus>'
                + '<small class="dm-hint" id="' + fieldId('name-hint') + '" data-ns-name-hint>' + esc(t('ns_name_hint')) + '</small></div>' + hostField() + '</div>'
                + '<div class="dm-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="' + esc(t('ns_source')) + '">' + tab('paste', t('ns_tab_paste')) + tab('convert', t('ns_tab_convert')) + '</div>'
                + '<div role="tabpanel" class="dm-ns-panel" id="' + fieldId('panel-paste') + '" aria-labelledby="' + fieldId('tab-paste') + '" data-ns-panel="paste"' + (s.tab === 'paste' ? '' : ' hidden') + '>'
                + '<p class="dm-hint">' + esc(t('ns_paste_hint')) + '</p><div data-ns-notes></div><div class="dm-ed-surface dm-ns-editor" data-ns-compose></div>'
                + '<details class="dm-advanced" data-ns-env><summary>' + esc(t('ns_env_optional')) + '</summary><div class="dm-ed-surface dm-ns-editor is-short" data-ns-envsurface></div></details></div>'
                + '<div role="tabpanel" class="dm-ns-panel" id="' + fieldId('panel-convert') + '" aria-labelledby="' + fieldId('tab-convert') + '" data-ns-panel="convert"' + (s.tab === 'convert' ? '' : ' hidden') + '>'
                + '<div class="dm-field"><label for="' + fieldId('command') + '">' + esc(t('ns_command')) + '</label><textarea id="' + fieldId('command') + '" name="command" rows="6" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" placeholder="docker run -d --name web -p 8080:80 nginx:1.27"></textarea></div>'
                + '<div class="dm-ns-convert-actions"><button type="button" class="dm-btn is-primary" data-ns="convert" data-focus-id="ns:convert"><span>' + esc(t('ns_convert')) + '</span></button><span class="dm-hint" data-ns-convert-state role="status"></span></div></div>'
                + '</section><aside class="dm-ns-preview" aria-label="' + esc(t('preview_title')) + '"><h3 class="dm-ns-preview-title">' + esc(t('preview_title')) + '</h3><div data-ns-preview></div></aside></div>'
                + '<footer class="dm-ns-foot"><p class="dm-form-error" role="alert" data-ns-error hidden></p><span class="dm-spacer"></span>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn" data-ns="save" data-focus-id="ns:save"><span>' + esc(t('ns_save_draft')) + '</span></button>'
                + '<button type="button" class="dm-btn is-primary" data-ns="deploy" data-focus-id="ns:deploy">' + views.glyph('deploy') + '<span>' + esc(t('action_deploy')) + '</span></button></footer></div>';
        }

        function showError(message, inputName) {
            const box = q('[data-ns-error]');
            if (!box) return;
            box.textContent = message || '';
            box.hidden = !message;
            if (inputName) q('[name="' + inputName + '"]')?.focus();
        }

        function paintBusy() {
            for (const button of el.querySelectorAll('[data-ns="save"], [data-ns="deploy"]')) {
                button.disabled = s.busy || !deps.canMutate();
                if (s.busy) button.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true'); else button.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
            }
        }

        function setTab(tab) {
            s.tab = tab;
            for (const button of el.querySelectorAll('[data-ns-tab]')) {
                const on = button.dataset.nsTab === tab;
                button.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(on));
                button.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
            }
            for (const panel of el.querySelectorAll('[data-ns-panel]')) panel.hidden = panel.dataset.nsPanel !== tab;
            if (tab === 'paste') compose?.refresh();
        }

        function suggestName(value) {
            const input = q('[name="name"]');
            if (!input || input.value.trim() || s.nameTouched || !value) return;
            input.value = sm.sanitizeName(value);
            nameProblem();
        }

        function mountEditors() {
            compose = editor.mount(q('[data-ns-compose]'), {
                label: t('editor_compose_label'), text: '', language: 'yaml', readOnly: !deps.canMutate(),
                onChange: text => { s.lint = text.trim() ? s.lint : null; linter.schedule(); suggestName(sm.firstServiceName(text)); paintPreview(); },
                onSave: () => { void submit(false); }, onDeploy: () => { void submit(true); }, onFix: diagnostic => fix(diagnostic.fix && diagnostic.fix.variable)
            });
            const details = q('[data-ns-env]');
            const mountEnv = () => {
                if (env || !details.open) return;
                env = editor.mount(q('[data-ns-envsurface]'), {
                    label: t('editor_env_label'), text: s.pendingEnv || '', language: 'plain', wrap: true, readOnly: !deps.canMutate(),
                    onChange: () => { linter.schedule(); paintPreview(); }, onSave: () => { void submit(false); }, onDeploy: () => { void submit(true); }
                });
                s.pendingEnv = '';
            };
            details.addEventListener('toggle', mountEnv, { signal: ac.signal });
        }

        // Adds NAME=<random> to the .env (opening the section and creating the editor when needed).
        function fix(name) {
            if (!name || !deps.canMutate()) return;
            const details = q('[data-ns-env]');
            if (!env) {
                s.pendingEnv = sm.appendEnvVariable(s.pendingEnv || '', name, sm.randomValue(32, window.crypto));
                details.open = true;
                details.dispatchEvent(new Event('toggle'));
            } else env.setText(sm.appendEnvVariable(env.getText(), name, sm.randomValue(32, window.crypto)));
            linter.schedule();
            paintPreview();
            announce(t('fix_env_done', { name }));
        }

        // ---- actions -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        function warningsHtml() {
            if (!s.warnings.length) return '';
            return '<div class="dm-note">' + views.glyph('warning') + '<div><strong>' + esc(t('ns_convert_warnings')) + '</strong><ul class="dm-pv-list">'
                + s.warnings.map(w => '<li>' + esc(sm.CONVERT_WARNINGS.includes(w.code) ? t('convert_' + w.code, { flag: w.flag }) : w.message) + '</li>').join('') + '</ul></div></div>';
        }

        async function convert() {
            const command = q('[name="command"]').value.trim(), state = q('[data-ns-convert-state]');
            if (!command) { state.textContent = t('ns_command_empty'); q('[name="command"]').focus(); return; }
            state.textContent = t('ns_converting');
            try {
                const result = await store.convertDockerRun(command);
                if (!s.open) return;
                compose.setText(String(result.compose || ''));
                s.warnings = Array.isArray(result.warnings) ? result.warnings : [];
                q('[data-ns-notes]').innerHTML = warningsHtml();
                suggestName(result.service);
                state.textContent = '';
                setTab('paste');
                compose.focus();
                linter.schedule();
                announce(t('ns_converted'));
            } catch (error) {
                if (!s.open) return;
                state.textContent = views.errorText(error.dm);
            }
        }

        async function submit(deploy) {
            if (s.busy || !deps.canMutate()) return;
            showError('');
            const problem = nameProblem();
            if (problem) { nameProblem(); showError(t('sv_name_' + problem.code), 'name'); return; }
            if (!composeText().trim()) { showError(t('ns_compose_empty')); setTab('paste'); compose.focus(); return; }
            s.busy = true;
            paintBusy();
            const name = nameValue();
            try {
                const body = await store.createStack(s.hostId, { name, compose: composeText(), env: envText(), deploy });
                if (!s.open) return;
                s.busy = false;
                if (deploy && body && body.deploy_error) {
                    // The files are written, only the start failed: the stack opens as a draft and the reason is shown.
                    const failed = t('ns_deploy_failed', { name, reason: views.errorText(body.deploy_error) });
                    announce(failed);
                    toast(failed, 'error');
                } else {
                    announce(t(deploy ? 'ns_deployed' : 'ns_saved', { name }));
                    toast(t(deploy ? 'ns_deployed' : 'ns_saved', { name }), 'success');
                }
                close(true);
                if (deps.onCreated) deps.onCreated(s.hostId, name, body);
            } catch (error) {
                s.busy = false;
                if (!s.open) return;
                paintBusy();
                const info = error.dm || {};
                if (info.code === 'host_not_prepared' || info.code === 'runner_image_missing') {
                    const entry = store.state.stacks[s.hostId], helpers = entry && entry.error && entry.error.data && entry.error.data.helpers;
                    const data = info.data || {};
                    showError(views.errorText(info));
                    if (info.code === 'host_not_prepared' && await dialogs.confirmPrepare({ hostName: hostName(s.hostId), image: (data.helpers || helpers || {}).runner_image || 'docker:29.9.2-cli' })) void deps.onPrepare(s.hostId);
                } else if (info.code === 'stack_name_invalid' || info.code === 'stack_exists') { nameProblem(); showError(views.errorText(info), 'name'); }
                else showError(views.errorText(info));
            }
        }

        function open(options) {
            const o = options || {};
            if (s.open) {
                if (o.compose != null && compose) compose.setText(o.compose);
                return;
            }
            const hosts = store.state.hosts;
            s.open = true;
            s.tab = 'paste';
            s.locked = !!o.lockHost;
            s.hostId = o.hostId && hosts.some(host => host.id === o.hostId) ? o.hostId : (hosts.find(host => sm.hostStacksState(store.state.stacks[host.id]) === 'ok') || hosts[0] || {}).id || '';
            s.lint = null;
            s.lintFailed = null;
            s.warnings = [];
            s.busy = false;
            s.nameTouched = false;
            s.pendingEnv = '';
            ac = new AbortController();
            el.innerHTML = markup();
            el.hidden = false;
            linter = deps.createLinter(
                () => {
                    if (!composeText().trim()) return Promise.resolve({ diagnostics: [], preview: { services: [], named_volumes: [], variables: [] } });
                    return store.lint(s.hostId, { compose: composeText(), env: envText() }, 'newstack');
                },
                (result, error) => { s.lint = result; s.lintFailed = result ? null : error; if (result) distribute(result); paintPreview(); });
            mountEditors();
            const signal = ac.signal;
            el.addEventListener('input', event => {
                if (event.target.matches('[name="name"]')) { s.nameTouched = true; nameProblem(); }
            }, { signal });
            el.addEventListener('change', event => {
                if (event.target.matches('[name="host"]')) { s.hostId = event.target.value; nameProblem(); linter.schedule(); }
            }, { signal });
            el.addEventListener('click', event => {
                const tab = event.target.closest('[data-ns-tab]'), action = event.target.closest('[data-ns]');
                if (tab) { setTab(tab.dataset.nsTab); return; }
                if (!action) return;
                switch (action.dataset.ns) {
                    case 'cancel': void deps.requestClose(); break;
                    case 'convert': void convert(); break;
                    case 'save': void submit(false); break;
                    case 'deploy': void submit(true); break;
                    case 'random': fix(action.dataset.variable); break;
                    default: break;
                }
            }, { signal });
            el.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
                const tab = event.target.closest('[data-ns-tab]');
                if (!tab || !['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Home', 'End'].includes(event.key)) return;
                event.preventDefault();
                const next = tab.dataset.nsTab === 'paste' ? 'convert' : 'paste';
                setTab(next);
                q('[data-ns-tab="' + next + '"]').focus();
            }, { signal });
            nameProblem();
            paintPreview();
            paintBusy();
            if (o.compose != null) compose.setText(o.compose);
            if (o.env != null) { s.pendingEnv = o.env; q('[data-ns-env]').open = true; q('[data-ns-env]').dispatchEvent(new Event('toggle')); }
            if (o.name) { q('[name="name"]').value = sm.sanitizeName(o.name); nameProblem(); }
            s.initial = snapshot();
            if (o.compose != null || o.env != null) linter.schedule();
            q('[name="name"]').focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }

        function close(force) {
            if (!s.open) return;
            s.open = false;
            linter?.dispose();
            linter = null;
            ac?.abort();
            compose?.dispose();
            env?.dispose();
            compose = env = null;
            el.replaceChildren();
            el.hidden = true;
            if (!force && deps.onClosed) deps.onClosed();
        }

        // Files dropped on the window: the compose file and the .env go into the editors; anything else is ignored with a note.
        async function acceptFiles(files) {
            let taken = 0;
            for (const file of Array.from(files || [])) {
                const kind = sm.classifyDroppedFile(file.name);
                if (!kind) continue;
                if (file.size > MAX_FILE_BYTES) { toast(views.errorText({ code: 'file_too_large' }), 'error'); continue; }
                const content = await file.text();
                if (!s.open) return taken;
                if (kind === 'compose') { compose.setText(content); suggestName(sm.firstServiceName(content)); setTab('paste'); }
                else {
                    if (env) env.setText(content);
                    else { s.pendingEnv = content; q('[data-ns-env]').open = true; q('[data-ns-env]').dispatchEvent(new Event('toggle')); }
                }
                taken += 1;
            }
            if (taken) { linter.schedule(); announce(t('ns_dropped', { count: taken })); } else toast(t('ns_drop_ignored'), 'error');
            return taken;
        }

        return { open, close, isOpen, isDirty, acceptFiles, dispose: () => close(true) };
    }

    window.DockerManagerNewStack = { create, MAX_FILE_BYTES };
})();

.dm-palette { display: grid; width: min(560px, 100%); max-height: min(70vh, 460px); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--vd-theme-border); border-radius: var(--vd-theme-radius-panel); background: var(--vd-theme-panel-bg-strong); box-shadow: var(--vd-theme-shadow-modal); }

/* New stack */
.dm-ns-wrap { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--vd-theme-app-bg); }
.dm-ns { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; height: 100%; min-height: 0; }

**Files:**

The root builds the new regions (the Stacks list and pane, the new-stack view, the progress drawer), switches sections (remembered as `section` in `docker-manager.ui.v1`), wires the store, the stack actions (deploy, update, restart, stop, pull, stop-and-remove, delete: destructive ones ask first, deploy and update save unsaved edits first), the palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K stops the event so Spotlight stays closed; the palette refuses to open over a dialog), the file drop (a drag with files is claimed with `preventDefault` + `stopPropagation` so the desktop does not upload it to the Desktop folder; read-only windows pass it on), the keyboard (Escape closes the innermost thing) and the context menus (the click that opens a desktop context menu must not reach the desktop, which closes its menu on every click it sees: `stack-more` stops it). `ctx` is unchanged: the app has its own dialog and toasts, so no `notify` or `modalDialog` is added to `menus-and-routing.js`.

The browser smoke drives the fake API below and the real shell (`desktopAuditBrowserWithAPI`): stack list and groups (the lock of the helper container says "Docker Manager helper" although the server also names docker_manager as its owner), an unprepared host (card, prepare operation with a streamed progress bar), open a stack (services, port link to the page host), the Compose tab (CodeMirror from the real bundle, the lint hint on the gutter and in the list), edit and Ctrl+S (the revision goes along), a revision conflict (diff dialog, overwrite with the host's revision), Update (the stream; the operation keeps running while a refresh asks for the active operations, whose list carries no output: the drawer must keep what the stream delivered), Ctrl+K (palette open, Spotlight closed; outside the app Spotlight opens), the unsaved-edits guard (Cancel keeps the edit, Discard moves on), a failed deploy that names a line (the Compose tab reopens with the line marked), delete (folder and volumes listed, the name typed), new stack by paste (name check, preview, Save draft), a deploy that cannot start (`deploy_error`: the draft opens, the error toast names the reason), convert docker run, a dropped compose file, an external project's restart, then the phase 1 Containers flows. A second test loads the page without the CodeMirror bundle and checks the plain textarea (Ctrl+S, the diagnostics list, go to line). The page the harness opens has a 30 s budget for the whole run: keep the fake streams short (60 ms per event).
